However, near-term QML architectures based on trainable parametrized quantum circuits remain affected by limited hardware resources, noise, and severe optimization difficulties such as barren plateaus. In this work we propose Soft-MoQE, a Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts architecture that replaces variational quantum training with the input-dependent selection and combination of fixed quantum feature maps. The model is composed of a heterogeneous pool of non-trainable quantum circuits, each defining a distinct embedding, and a classical gating network that learns how to weight these embeddings for each data point. We benchmark Soft-MoQE on three PCA-reduced tasks: MNIST parity, MNIST 10-class, and FashionMNIST. Soft-MoQE outperforms the single best expert, the uniform average of all experts and a linear baseline, achieving task-dependent performance comparable to that of a trainable quantum neural network, without optimizing any quantum parameter and with a quantum training cost that is lower by orders of magnitude. The analysis of the class- conditioned expert usage shows that the learned routing combines a few experts for each input, with a selection that depends on the class. These results support the learned routing among fixed quantum circuits as a trainability-aware design principle for hybrid QML.
items.title_ko: 하이브리드 양자-클래식 학습을 위한 양자 전문가의 Soft Mixture
items.summary_ko: 양자 기계 학습(QML)은 클래식 모델로 재현하기 어려운 특징 표현을 구축할 가능성으로 주목받고 있습니다. 이 연구는 변분 양자 훈련을 대체하는 Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts(Soft-MoQE) 아키텍처를 제안하여, 양자 컴퓨팅의 한계와 최적화 어려움을 해결하고자 합니다.
items.why_ko: 양자 AI의 실제 적용 가능성을 높이는 하이브리드 학습 방법론으로, 현재 양자 하드웨어의 한계를 극복하고 잠재력을 최대한 활용하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Bias-Only Training Dynamics in ReLU Networks
items.body: Neural networks with randomly initialized, fixed weights and trainable biases are universal approximators, yet the dynamics of bias-only training remain largely unexplored. We study these dynamics in one-hidden-layer ReLU networks through activation codes, the binary patterns of active neurons that partition the input space into convex polyhedral regions. We show that the gradients with respect to the biases depend on each input only through its activation code, and hence the training dynamics can be characterized with these codes. In particular, as long as the activation codes remain fixed, training reduces to a linear least-squares problem with the codes as features. Training can then be understood as a sequence of least-squares problems, with transitions occurring when neurons change their activation states. We show that the fraction of switching neurons vanishes as the network widens, and the training dynamics approach those of linear least squares on the initial activation codes in the infinite-width limit. Our experiments support these theoretical findings, showing that while activation switches can noticeably affect training in narrower networks, their relative frequency and the associated changes in the dynamics diminish as the width increases.
items.title_ko: ReLU 네트워크의 Bias-Only 훈련 동역학
items.summary_ko: 무작위로 초기화되고 가중치가 고정된 ReLU 네트워크에서 편향(bias)만 훈련하는 동역학을 활성화 코드(activation codes)를 통해 연구했습니다. 편향에 대한 경사는 각 입력에 대해 활성화 코드에만 의존하며, 훈련 동역학이 활성화 코드에 의해 인코딩된 각 입력에 대해 활성화 코드에 의존함을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 신경망 훈련의 기본 메커니즘 중 하나인 편향 업데이트에 대한 심층적인 이해를 제공하여, 모델 최적화 및 학습 효율성 향상에 대한 통찰력을 줄 수 있습니다.

items.title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
items.body: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.
items.title_ko: 질문의 코끼리: 통합 모델이 답변 뒤의 개념을 그린다
items.summary_ko: 통합된 멀티모달 모델은 텍스트 처리 중 형성된 표현에 접근하여 중간 표현을 시각화할 수 있습니다. V-lens는 디코더 훈련 없이 선택된 토큰의 숨겨진 상태를 시각화하는 방법을 제시하며, 확산 기반 및 순수 자기회귀 통합 모델에서 이 연결을 활용합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 추론 과정을 시각화하여 '블랙박스' 문제를 해결하고 모델의 투명성을 높이는 데 기여합니다. 이는 AI 모델 개발 및 디버깅에 매우 유용합니다.

items.title: Training-free motion statistics match self-supervised behavior encoders
items.body: Self-supervised encoders for animal behavior are often trained on, or fed, hand-built movement features. We ask whether they beat those ingredients when compared fairly. A training-free representation, made of generic per-frame measurements summarized over fixed time windows and reduced with PCA, is compared with retrained and released encoders (BAMS, hBehaveMAE) under a preregistered protocol: frozen representations of equal size and one shared classifier. On CalMS21 it reaches 85.8 macro F1 against 82.4 for the best encoder, ties with four labelled videos, and leads when the annotator changes or new behaviors must be learned from a few videos; the reading holds for encoders retrained with three seeds. On the MABe22 mouse triplets it scores 83.7 against 80.3 for the released hBehaveMAE (gap +3.4, 95% interval +2.1 to +4.7). On a second species, the MABe22 fly groups, the same recipe scores 51.6 mean F1 over 50 tasks against 48.2 for BAMS, the best published method. On Shot7M2, the synthetic basketball benchmark built by hBehaveMAE's authors, it scores 68.8 against 64.7 for hBehaveMAE, the best method in that paper, though hBehaveMAE remains better on the shortest movements. Short time windows carry most of the result. Raw keypoints in each body's own frame, summarized over the same windows, already match or beat the encoders on both mouse datasets and on Shot7M2; on the fly groups they fall short, and the measurements add 5.3 points. On these benchmarks, current behavior encoders have yet to beat the hand-built features they learn from, and such baselines should be reported alongside them.
items.title_ko: 훈련 없는 움직임 통계가 자가 지도 행동 인코더와 일치한다
items.summary_ko: 동물 행동을 위한 자가 지도 인코더는 종종 수동으로 구축된 움직임 특징으로 훈련되거나 제공됩니다. 이 연구는 공정한 비교를 통해, 훈련 없는 표현(고정된 시간 창에 걸쳐 요약된 일반적인 프레임별 측정치로 구성되고 PCA로 축소된)이 재훈련되거나 출시된 인코더보다 우수할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 동물 행동 분석을 위한 효율적인 특징 표현 방식을 탐구하며, 복잡한 훈련 없이도 높은 성능을 달성할 수 있는 가능성을 제시하여 AI 모델 개발의 새로운 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: Isabelle Pool Server: a pooled verification service for prover training and multi-agent proving
items.body: Isabelle Pool Server (IPS), a verification service with a pool of warm headless Isabelle sessions behind an HTTP API, with session leasing and reclamation, memory-aware admission control, and a time budget on every call. Its verification interface spans single-step execution, block-level proof checking and whole-theory builds, with checkpoints for cheap branching and backtracking, and a build from scratch as the final arbiter. The service runs as a single container with monitoring and is accessible via a Python client, two MCP servers and a raw HTTP API. In our measurements IPS is level with PIDE MCP, a PIDE frontend for agents, at one worker and ahead of it at eight, at its commit of October 2026 (the tool is now PIDE AI). Once its sessions are up it scales to 32 concurrent workers on one host at 24 times the single-worker rate, and under memory pressure it refuses new sessions rather than losing existing ones. IPS is free software and publicly available at https://github.com/Deep-LCF/Isabelle-Pool-Server
items.title_ko: Isabelle Pool Server: 증명기 훈련 및 다중 에이전트 증명을 위한 풀링된 검증 서비스
items.summary_ko: Isabelle Pool Server(IPS)는 HTTP API를 통해 풀링된 Isabelle 세션을 제공하는 검증 서비스입니다. 세션 임대 및 회수, 메모리 인식 입학 제어, 호출별 시간 예산 기능을 갖추고 있으며, 단일 컨테이너로 실행되어 모니터링 및 접근이 용이합니다.
items.why_ko: 자동화된 증명 및 AI 기반 소프트웨어 검증 분야에서 효율적인 인프라를 제공하여, 복잡한 시스템의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Learning Trajectories Leave Decodable Traces in Neural Network Weight Space and Internal Representations
items.body: Neural networks trained on the same task develop related weight-space structures, yet remain distinguishable after learning. Do these differences merely reflect alternative solutions, or do they preserve information about individual learning histories? We tested whether final weights reveal initialization, task order, and earlier trajectory states. Training reorganized the ensemble: initial pairwise distances did not consistently predict final distances. Nevertheless, all 30 trained networks were correctly matched to their initial weights among ten candidates per dataset. Networks sharing an initialization also developed recognizable final hidden representations across different batch schedules, although direct comparisons with initial activity did not recover identity. Learning order remained readable as well. A linear probe decoded the order of two earlier tasks with 100% accuracy on 80 held-out networks after ten epochs of a common final task. Earlier intermediate weight states were partly predictable, but individual initial weights could not be reliably reconstructed. Final weights thus retain selective historical information rather than a complete trajectory record. Perturbed networks recovered classification performance without returning to their unperturbed training paths. This separation persisted across datasets, intervention times, and network layers. Moreover, 2,157 of 2,160 aligned endpoint pairs showed no positive loss barrier at sampled interpolation points, indicating low-loss connections between distinct solutions rather than convergence to one weight vector. Together, these findings show that a shared task constrains networks to related successful solutions without erasing their individual histories. Final weights reflect not only what a network has learned, but also where learning began and how it unfolded.
items.title_ko: 학습 궤적이 신경망 가중치 공간과 내부 표현에 해독 가능한 흔적을 남긴다
items.summary_ko: 동일한 작업으로 훈련된 신경망은 관련 가중치 공간 구조를 개발하지만, 학습 후에도 구별 가능합니다. 이 연구는 최종 가중치가 초기화, 작업 순서 및 이전 궤적 상태에 대한 정보를 보존하는지 테스트했습니다.
items.why_ko: 신경망의 학습 과정과 최종 상태 간의 관계를 탐구하여, 모델이 어떻게 학습하고 어떤 정보를 보존하는지에 대한 이해를 깊게 합니다. 이는 모델 해석 가능성 연구에 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: Reconstruction vs. Prediction Pre-Training of Discrete Video Representations for Continuous Control
items.body: Self-supervised video encoders are commonly trained to either reconstruct pixels or predict latent features, yet it remains unclear how these objectives shape representations for downstream dynamics. We present a capacity-matched study isolating this choice: two identical video encoders with a shared FSQ bottleneck are trained under autoencoding and V-JEPA objectives on a continuous control environment. We introduce a simple asymmetric discretization scheme to apply the same bottleneck to the predictive model. The resulting representations exhibit a clear trade-off: the autoencoder preserves substantially more physical state information and achieves slightly better one-step latent prediction, while the predictive encoder accumulates less error under autoregressive rollout. Structural probes suggest that this advantage is associated with greater robustness to low-level visual perturbations and stronger dependence on temporal context. These results indicate that predictive and reconstructive objectives induce distinct representations of dynamics, trading state fidelity for properties that may benefit long-horizon prediction.
items.title_ko: 연속 제어를 위한 이산 비디오 표현의 재구성 vs. 예측 사전 훈련
items.summary_ko: 자가 지도 비디오 인코더는 픽셀 재구성 또는 잠재 특징 예측을 위해 훈련되지만, 이러한 목적이 다운스트림 동역학에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지는 불분명합니다. 이 연구는 동일한 FSQ 병목 현상을 공유하는 두 개의 동일한 비디오 인코더를 자동 인코딩 및 V-JEPA 목표 하에 연속 제어 환경에서 훈련하는 용량 일치 연구를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 표현 학습의 핵심적인 선택이 다운스트림 제어 작업에 미치는 영향을 이해하여, 로봇 공학 및 자율 시스템을 위한 효율적인 모델 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
items.body: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.
items.title_ko: 반사실 월드 모델: '만약 ~라면'을 추론하는 JEPA
items.summary_ko: 월드 모델은 완전히 관찰할 수 없는 세계에서 작동하며, 숨겨진 교란이 행동 결과를 바꿀 때 반사실적 질문이 따릅니다. 이 연구는 사실적 전이(factual transitions)로 훈련된 월드 모델은 이러한 질문에 스스로 답변할 수 없음을 증명하고, 물리 시스템에서 관찰된 결과와 교란 조건 하의 다른 행동을 분리하여 설명합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 더 복잡한 환경에서 효과적으로 의사결정하기 위해 필요한 '반사실적 추론' 능력을 모델링하는 데 대한 중요한 이론적 및 실용적 기반을 제시합니다.

items.title: LLM-Guided Cyber-Physical Attack Path Identification in Smart Grids
items.body: Identifying high-impact attack paths in cyber-physical power systems is critical for improving grid resilience. Existing methods typically rely on either structural topology analysis or simulation-based cascading-failure models. Topology-based approaches capture connectivity but lack adversarial reasoning, while simulation-driven methods are primarily suited for offline analysis and are less effective for rapid evaluation of evolving attack scenarios. As a result, identifying realistic attack paths that jointly capture topology, threat semantics, and physical impact remains challenging. This paper presents a physics-grounded framework for identifying cyber-physical attack paths using large language models (LLMs), with cascading-failure-derived impact rankings used as physics-grounded references. The framework integrates system topology, LLM-guided STRIDE and MITRE ATT&CK threat modeling, and three baseline strategies for comparison: topology-driven, threat-driven, and fusion-based. Evaluation is performed using (i) critical-node overlap between LLM-inferred top-K rankings and cascading-failure-based ground truth; (ii) node-level similarity between LLM-inferred and reference paths; and (iii) path-level alignment capturing agreement in complete attack sequences. Results show that structured LLM-based threat modeling substantially improves alignment with physics-grounded references. In the cyber layer, critical-node overlap@3 increases from approximately 33% to as high as 100%, while node-level similarity reaches up to 65% and path-level alignment reaches up to 48%. In addition, the proposed framework reduces runtime by approximately 75--85% compared to the fusion-based baseline in the IEEE 14-bus system. These results suggest that LLM-guided attack path identification is a promising approach for efficient and impact-aware cyber-physical security analysis.
items.title_ko: LLM 기반 스마트 그리드 사이버 물리 공격 경로 식별
items.summary_ko: 사이버 물리 전력 시스템에서 고위험 공격 경로를 식별하는 것은 그리드 복원력을 높이는 데 중요합니다. 기존 방법들은 구조적 토폴로지 분석이나 시뮬레이션 기반 연쇄 실패 모델에 의존하지만, 이 연구는 LLM을 활용하여 진화하는 공격 시나리오를 신속하게 평가하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 복잡한 인프라 시스템의 보안 분석에 활용될 수 있음을 보여주며, 스마트 그리드와 같은 중요 시스템의 사이버 복원력을 강화하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
items.body: Learning the spatiotemporal dynamics of cells from spatial transcriptomics requires connecting snapshots of different cells acquired in different coordinate frames. A rotation or translation of a section can appear as cell movement and distort the inferred correspondence. We introduce horizontal flow matching, which learns changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance up to shared rigid motion. The dynamics follow a continuity--reaction equation whose action assigns no cost to shared rigid motion, and the resulting horizontal projector removes this component from spatial prediction errors during learning and from predicted velocities during generation. An equivalent endpoint problem jointly estimates correspondence and relative pose in Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry and yields analytic paths whose velocity and growth serve as regression targets. Regressing these targets recovers the horizontal dynamics under ideal population conditions. Our model, HORIZON, uses an equivariant transformer to predict velocity and growth from the current tissue, so that a tissue can be generated continuously from a single initial snapshot. On a simulated tissue observed in perturbed coordinate frames, alignment improves reconstruction and projection reduces rigid drift. On four spatial transcriptomics time courses, HORIZON reconstructs tissue geometry, gene expression, and cell abundance more accurately than existing spatial and unbalanced trajectory methods, and interpolates held-out developmental stages.
items.title_ko: 단일 세포 시공간 역학을 위한 수평 흐름 매칭
items.summary_ko: 공간 전사체학에서 세포의 시공간 역학을 학습하려면 다른 좌표 프레임에서 획득한 다른 세포의 스냅샷을 연결해야 합니다. 이 연구는 조직 조직, 분자 상태 및 세포 풍부도의 변화를 공유된 강체 운동까지 학습하는 수평 흐름 매칭을 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 생물학적 시스템의 복잡한 동역학을 모델링하는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 질병 진행 및 약물 반응 연구에 대한 이해를 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridges
items.body: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training. We show that the minimizers of the expected training objectives recover the optimal unbalanced Schrödinger bridge. Empirically, Elysium reconstructs state transitions, population size, and event distributions on simulated benchmarks with known killed-diffusion ground truth, outperforming existing deterministic and bridge-based solvers. On single-cell time courses, it interpolates cell state distributions at unobserved time points, tracks population expansion and contraction, and captures biphasic drug-response dynamics.
items.title_ko: Elysium: 시뮬레이션 없는 불균형 슈뢰딩거 브릿지
items.summary_ko: 스냅샷으로부터 세포 역학을 재구성하는 것은 어렵습니다. Elysium은 시뮬레이션 없는 불균형 슈뢰딩거 브릿지 모델을 제안하여, 세포 증식 및 세포자멸사를 통한 개체군 크기 변화를 포함한 개별 이벤트를 모델링합니다.
items.why_ko: 단일 세포 측정의 한계를 극복하고 세포 개체군 변화를 정량적으로 모델링하는 새로운 방법을 제시하여 생물학 및 의학 연구에 기여합니다.

items.title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
items.body:
Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree.
In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average treatment effect between two policies, which has a closed-form solution for any fixed control variate. Second, we use historical logs to jointly optimize the logging policy and a control variate to further reduce variance. Our experimental results in simulated policy A/B tests show that our designs estimate the average treatment effect more accurately than existing variance reduction methods on every evaluated setting, while generally improving statistical power and reducing how often the worse policy is selected. As a result, our designs enable practitioners to reach reliable deployment decisions with considerably less online traffic.
items.title_ko: 분산 최적의 반사실 정책 설계로 샘플 효율적인 온라인 A/B 테스트
items.summary_ko: 온라인 A/B 테스트는 사용자 대면 시스템 변경을 평가하는 표준 방식이지만, 높은 분산으로 어려움을 겪습니다. 이 연구는 치료 및 생산 정책이 동일한 행동을 유사한 확률로 선택할 때 발생하는 노이즈 문제를 해결하고 샘플 효율성을 높이는 분산 최적의 반사실 정책 설계(Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design)를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 온라인 A/B 테스트의 효율성을 높여 제품 개발 주기 단축 및 의사결정 신뢰도 향상에 기여합니다. 이는 데이터 기반 제품 개발자에게 매우 유용합니다.

items.title: Learning the Anyon Atlas
items.body: We extend our previous search for the modular data of topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions from 22 to 42 anyons, identifying 150,679 new modular data. We do so by adding to our algorithm three rejection gates, two of them based on logistic regression, that discard representations of $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ unlikely to yield modular data. We estimate that roughly 80% of the modular data between ranks 23 and 42 has been identified after closing under known constructions. With this data, we find counterexamples to a conjecture of Geiko and Moore that the reality of the higher Gauss sums suffices for time-reversal symmetry in Chern-Simons theories, and propose a refined criterion. We demonstrate the scalability of this gated implementation by identifying prime modular data at rank 100 that is not realized by any Chern-Simons theory. The identified data through rank 42 has been made available at https://AnyonAtlas.org, to which further data will be added as it is found.
items.title_ko: Anyon Atlas 학습
items.summary_ko: 2+1차원 위상 양자장 이론의 모듈러 데이터를 검색하는 연구를 22개 애니온에서 42개 애니온으로 확장하여 150,679개의 새로운 모듈러 데이터를 식별했습니다. 로지스틱 회귀 기반의 세 가지 거부 게이트를 알고리즘에 추가하여 모듈러 데이터를 생성할 가능성이 낮은 $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ 표현을 제거합니다.
items.why_ko: 기초 과학 연구는 중요하지만, AI 개발자의 실무에 직접적인 관련성은 적습니다.

items.title: Cross-Vehicle Transferability of Lateral Velocity Estimation on Production Vehicles through Input Selection and Data Augmentation
items.body: Lateral velocity is safety-critical for vehicle-dynamics control but cannot be measured with production sensors. Model-based estimators such as Kalman filters are established, whereas data-driven estimators are more accurate within the training regime but suspected to lose accuracy beyond it. Their transfer to a structurally different vehicle has rarely been tested. We record real-world test drives of three series-production vehicles, train a neural-network estimator on production CAN signals of a compact car, and evaluate it zero-shot on an SUV and a van against a GNSS-aided inertial reference. On the unseen vehicles, the network's error exceeds that on the training vehicle by an order of magnitude, a gap not quantified on production vehicles before. A systematic comparison of input sets from ten production CAN signals identifies a five-signal set that transfers most robustly. To narrow this gap, we introduce three physically motivated augmentations of training data. Two improve generalization, namely exploiting the vehicle's left-right symmetry and emulating accelerometer bias. Combined, they reduce the error on the validation maneuvers of the SUV and van by 13% and 15%. Contrary to common expectation, on the SUV the data-driven estimator trained with both augmentations matches a model-based estimator tuned on the same training data.
items.title_ko: 입력 선택 및 데이터 증강을 통한 생산 차량 측면 속도 추정의 차량 간 전이성
items.summary_ko: 측면 속도는 차량 동역학 제어에 중요하지만 생산 센서로 측정할 수 없습니다. 모델 기반 추정기는 확립되어 있지만, 데이터 기반 추정기는 훈련 범위 내에서는 정확도가 높지만 그 외에서는 정확도가 떨어진다는 의심을 받습니다. 이 연구는 구조적으로 다른 차량으로의 전이성을 테스트합니다.
items.why_ko: 자율주행 및 차량 제어 시스템에서 AI 모델의 일반화 및 전이 학습 능력은 실제 적용을 위해 매우 중요하며, 이 연구는 실제 차량 데이터 기반으로 모델의 강건성을 평가합니다.

items.title: Sex Differences in the Detection of Parkinson's Disease from Speech
items.body: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disease in the world, and 70\% to 75\% of PD patients suffer from speech disorders at some stage. Since PD affects men more frequently than women, previous publications tend to rely on unbalanced datasets that potentially introduce sex biases into trained models. This study investigates sex differences in PD detection from speech using deep learning and traditional machine learning approaches. We evaluated speech-based PD detection using embeddings from three pre-trained speech models, combined with handcrafted acoustic features and different classifiers. Sex-specific experiments were conducted on balanced subsets of four sustained phonation datasets, controlling for sex, disease status, and, where possible, age. All recordings were obtained during a sustained phonation task. Results show that female speakers were more accurately classified than male speakers in the larger dataset. Sex-specific results show that when the models are trained on one sex, they fail to generalize to the other one. Our results highlight the importance of including sex as a variable in the development of PD detection systems.
items.title_ko: 말에서 파킨슨병 탐지의 성별 차이
items.summary_ko: 파킨슨병(PD)은 전 세계적으로 두 번째로 흔한 신경퇴행성 질환이며, PD 환자의 70%~75%가 언어 장애를 겪습니다. 이 연구는 딥러닝 및 전통적인 머신러닝 접근 방식을 사용하여 말 기반 PD 탐지에서 성별 차이를 조사합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 분야 AI의 중요한 주제이지만, 개발자들에게 직접적인 실무 지식을 제공하지는 않습니다.

items.title: Uneven gains in protein-RNA affinity and mutation-effect prediction
items.body: Accurate matched affinities determine mutation effects, but gains in aggregate affinity prediction may transfer unevenly to average effects, ordering and local accuracy. We evaluated eleven method families using method-specific matched populations. Controlled CoPRA reduced absolute-affinity mean absolute error from 1.2898 to 1.1431 pKd. Across 220 mutation pairs from 20 families, it generated stronger responses and improved mean-effect accuracy, with uncertain ranking gains and no decrease in mean centered local error. In an independent external test (24 quantitative pairs from three source-matched families), absolute and ordinary mutation-effect errors fell in all three families. Mean centered local error fell from 0.4198 to 0.3761 pKd, with improvements in two families and higher error in one. Error decomposition localized gains in landscape means. PRA-Pred feature tracing, fixed-weight M2-PRNet input controls and matched supervision interventions identified specific restrictions on mutation response. These results establish the need to evaluate average effects, ordering and quantitative local variation jointly.
items.title_ko: 단백질-RNA 친화도 및 돌연변이 효과 예측의 불균등한 이득
items.summary_ko: 정확하게 일치하는 친화도는 돌연변이 효과를 결정하지만, 전체 친화도 예측의 이득이 평균 효과, 순서 지정 및 국소 정확도로 불균등하게 전이될 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 방법론별로 일치하는 모집단을 사용하여 11가지 방법론군을 평가했습니다.
items.why_ko: 생명과학 분야의 전문 연구 내용으로, AI 개발자의 실무에 직접적인 관련성은 적습니다.

items.title: Approximate Dynamic Programming with Basis Function Learning
items.body: This work presents a novel approach for approximating the value function in Markov decision processes (MDPs). Our approach is grounded in the approximate linear programming (ALP) framework, wherein basis functions (BFs) play an important role. Traditionally, BFs have been pre-defined, randomly generated, or restricted to specific structures, which both limits the accuracy that can be achieved and leaves no mechanism for improving a given approximation. We instead learn BFs from the model itself, by repeatedly applying the Bellman operator to the current value estimate. We introduce the Bellman operator basis function (BOBF) learning method, and prove that each learned BF improves the approximation by a quantifiable amount and that the method converges to the optimal value function. Its shrunken counterpart (SBOBF) retains this guarantee while capping the number of BFs, and therefore the computational effort per iteration. For large-scale problems, where the number of constraints is prohibitive, we develop hybrid variants (HBOBF and SHBOBF) that combine constraint sampling with BF learning, and we show that the improvement and finite-termination guarantees are preserved under explicitly stated conditions. Numerical experiments on (continuous) perishable inventory and queueing control problems demonstrate that our BF learning techniques significantly outperform existing methods in the literature.
items.title_ko: 기저 함수 학습을 통한 근사 동적 프로그래밍
items.summary_ko: 마르코프 의사결정 과정(MDP)에서 가치 함수를 근사하기 위한 새로운 접근 방식을 제시합니다. 기존 ALP 프레임워크는 미리 정의되거나 무작위로 생성된 기저 함수에 의존했지만, 이 연구는 모델 자체로부터 기저 함수를 학습하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습 및 동적 프로그래밍 분야에서 가치 함수 근사의 정확도를 높이는 것은 에이전트의 성능 개선에 중요하며, 기저 함수 학습은 이 분야의 새로운 연구 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: How Generative Models Generate: A Concise Guide to the Generative AI Landscape
items.body: The rapidly expanding generative AI landscape brings together methods that differ in architecture, learning objective, mathematical representation and sampling procedure. A concise, selectively organised technical guide can provide an accessible starting point for developing a coherent understanding of this increasingly complex landscape. This article takes a generation-centred approach, connecting how models produce new observations with the modelling and learning principles that make generation possible. We develop a two-level perspective: first, distinguishing three recurring generation routes-direct transformation or decoding, sequential conditional construction, and iterative updating or transport; and second, examining the modelling and learning principles underlying these routes. Representative approaches are introduced through their key components, learning objectives and sampling procedures. We then examine their broader connections, including how different architectures and generation mechanisms can overlap or be combined. By bringing together essential technical explanations within a compact conceptual framework, the article aims to help readers develop a working understanding of unfamiliar approaches, recognise connections among models they have encountered, and navigate different approaches within the broader generative AI landscape.
items.title_ko: 생성 모델은 어떻게 생성하는가: 생성형 AI 환경에 대한 간결한 가이드
items.summary_ko: 빠르게 확장하는 생성형 AI 환경은 아키텍처, 학습 목적, 수학적 표현, 샘플링 절차가 다른 방법들을 통합합니다. 이 간결하고 선별적으로 조직된 기술 가이드는 생성 모델이 새로운 관찰을 생성하는 방법과 생성형 AI의 모델링 및 학습 원리를 연결하여 포괄적인 이해를 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: 생성형 AI 기술의 핵심 원리와 다양한 모델들을 체계적으로 이해하는 데 도움이 되는 실용적인 가이드로, 개발자들이 빠르게 변화하는 생성형 AI 분야를 따라잡는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
items.body: The rapid expansion of gravitational-wave astronomy and high-precision numerical relativity has created an acute computational bottleneck: direct numerical integration of the Einstein field equations and high-dimensional Bayesian parameter estimation require millions of waveform evaluations that cannot be sustained by traditional solvers alone. Reduced-order modeling (ROM) and surrogate techniques have emerged as foundational tools to bridge this gap, compressing high-fidelity solution manifolds into compact, rapidly evaluable representations without sacrificing physical accuracy. This perspective reviews the mathematical pillars of projection-based reduced-order modeling---including Proper Orthogonal Decomposition, greedy basis selection, and the Empirical Interpolation Method---and traces their operational impact in gravitational-wave data analysis through surrogate waveform families and Reduced-Order Quadratures. We then examine the fundamental approximation barriers posed by slow Kolmogorov n-width decay in non-stationary, transient, and strongly nonlinear regimes, showing how adaptive hp-greedy domain partitioning and multi-scale spectral compression overcome these limits. Finally, we discuss how combining certified reduced-order structures with modern scientific machine learning and sensitivity-aware quantization provides a rigorous blueprint for next-generation detectors such as LISA, Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer.
items.title_ko: 중력파 물리학 및 수치 상대론의 서러게이트 모델링 및 축소 차수 방법: 스펙트럼 표현에서 적응형 압축까지
items.summary_ko: 중력파 천문학 및 고정밀 수치 상대론의 급속한 확장은 심각한 계산 병목 현상을 초래합니다. 이 연구는 축소 차수 모델링(ROM) 및 서러게이트 기술이 이 격차를 해소하고 고충실도 솔루션 매니폴드를 압축하는 데 필수적인 도구로 부상했음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 과학 계산 분야의 전문 연구로, AI 개발자의 실무에 직접적인 관련성은 적습니다.

items.title: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
items.body: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.
items.title_ko: SLAM-ASR 음성 인식 모델의 귀납 헤드 기원
items.summary_ko: 인코더 상태에서 고정된 언어 모델의 임베딩 공간으로의 작은 훈련된 매핑이 경쟁력 있는 음성 인식에 충분한 이유는 무엇일까요? SLAM-ASR 아키텍처의 전제는 고정된 언어 모델이 인식 작업을 수행하기에 충분히 풍부한 언어 지식을 가지고 있다는 것입니다. 이 연구는 이러한 모델이 의존하는 구체적인 내부 구조를 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 음성 인식 모델의 핵심 작동 메커니즘을 이해하는 것은 더욱 효율적이고 정확한 모델을 설계하는 데 도움이 되며, LLM의 언어 지식 활용 방안에 대한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
items.body: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
items.title_ko: DRIFT: 런타임 유연하고 효율적인 엔드투엔드 주행을 위한 분리형 추론
items.summary_ko: Vision-Language Models (VLMs)를 엔드투엔드(E2E) 자율주행에 통합하는 것은 강력한 잠재력을 보여주지만, VLMs는 계산 비용이 비싸고 런타임에 언어 추론을 켜고 끄는 것이 어렵습니다. DRIFT는 경량 언어 모델을 통합하여 이 문제를 해결하는 E2E 자율주행 프레임워크입니다.
items.why_ko: 자율주행과 같은 실시간 응용 분야에서 대규모 AI 모델의 계산 효율성을 높이는 것은 중요한 과제입니다. DRIFT는 VLM의 장점을 활용하면서도 런타임 성능을 유지하는 실용적인 접근 방식을 제시합니다.

items.title: Meta-LSQ: A Closed-Form Sobolev Inner Solver for Few-Shot Meta-Learning
items.body: Gradient-based meta-learners such as model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) adapt to a new task with an inner loop of gradient descent that has to be differentiated through, and they meta-learn every network weight. Meta-LSQ instead fits each task with one regularised least-squares solve over a fixed random Fourier basis and meta-learns only three scalars, a bandwidth, a ridge and a derivative weight. Since the derivative of a sinusoid is again a sinusoid, the same solve can also take derivative observations, and the fitted model has exact closed-form derivatives of any order. On 10-shot sinusoid regression Meta-LSQ trains in 14 s and ends with a 5.5 times lower error than a first-order MAML baseline that trains 36 times longer, and a Gaussian-process control suggests that most of this gain comes from sharing one kernel across tasks. In simulated beam tuning at DESY's ARES facility with model derivatives it is slightly more accurate than an ALPaCA-style model and well ahead of gradient descent. Over DESY's full range of target beams, again in simulation and from measurements alone, its best setting has a median error of 7.3 $μ$m, against 14.4 for the published final beams of their reinforcement-learning agent, which has the lower median on their 300 trials of small targets. On real sensor-calibration data a learned prior mean puts it ahead of MAML on two of four targets, but an exact Gaussian process with the same change and an ALPaCA-style model stay more accurate on most targets, and it breaks down on non-smooth targets. On noiseless targets outside the span of the basis, in-sample criteria such as generalised cross-validation choose too small a ridge.

items.title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
items.body: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.
items.title_ko: Openhagen Worlds: 과학적 발견 에이전트 측정 및 훈련을 위한 보정된 환경
items.summary_ko: Openhagen Worlds는 27개의 절차적으로 생성된 환경(일부는 유한한 진리 공간을 가짐) 모음으로, 과학을 수행하는 에이전트가 정보성 실험을 선택하고 결과로부터 추론하는 능력을 측정하고 훈련하기 위해 고안되었습니다. 이 환경은 예산 내에서 실험을 실행하고 확정적인 정답을 제출하도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: AI가 과학적 발견 과정을 자동화하는 능력을 체계적으로 평가하고 훈련할 수 있는 환경을 제공하여, AI 기반 과학 연구의 발전을 가속화할 수 있습니다.

items.title: F$^3$: What Makes Good Experience in World-Action Models?
items.body: Deployed world-action models (WAMs) can keep improving only if they make good use of their own experience. Existing methods supply retrieved rollouts or demonstrations to the policy as context, yet such experience often turns previously solved tasks into failures. What, then, makes good experience for a WAM? We show that experience is valuable only in use: its value depends not on whether the source rollout succeeded but on what is stored, when it is used, and where it enters the policy. We therefore propose F$^3$, which makes these three decisions with Form, Fit, and Fusion. Form compresses successful and failed rollouts alike into short, verified operation records; Fit teaches the policy to read a record and to predict when it helps; Fusion injects the record's images, text and actions into the policy as a prefix and an action prior. Trained once on only 200 examples and deployed with a growing experience library, the model achieves state-of-the-art results on MolmoSpaces and RoboLab without any training on RoboLab: over native Cosmos 3 Nano, it raises success by 12.0 pp and 10.8 pp, reduces steps to success by 12.2% and 11.3%, and cuts regressions by 57%.
items.title_ko: F$^3$: 월드-액션 모델에서 '좋은 경험'을 만드는 요소는 무엇인가?
items.summary_ko: 배포된 월드-액션 모델(WAM)은 자신의 경험을 잘 활용해야만 계속 개선될 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 WAM에게 '좋은 경험'이 무엇인지 탐구하며, 경험의 가치가 소스 롤아웃의 성공 여부보다는 무엇이 저장되고, 언제 사용되며, 정책에 어떻게 통합되는지에 달려 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습 에이전트가 효과적으로 학습하고 자가 개선하는 방법을 이해하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, 경험 재사용 전략을 최적화하여 AI 에이전트의 성능을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? A Controlled Study of Dialectal Adaptation for Québec French
items.body: Continual pre-training (CPT) is widely used to adapt pretrained language models to dialectal and non-standard language varieties, yet it remains unclear when this additional training is necessary, what drives its benefits, and whether aggregate evaluation scores adequately capture its effects. In this paper, we present a controlled study of CPT for Québec French language understanding across nine LLMs spanning different families and scales. Using a budget-matched protocol of 30M tokens per experiment, our results show that the benefit of CPT depends strongly on the starting model's existing competence in the target variety. When CPT is beneficial, the improvements are driven more by corpus composition than by data volume, with literary text accounting for most of the gain. Paired Québec and standard French evaluations further show that CPT primarily improves expression comprehension rather than grammatical competence, and that corpus register determines which regional expressions are acquired. These gains also involve capability-specific trade-offs, including declines in reading comprehension that aggregate scores can conceal. Overall, these findings show that CPT for dialectal adaptation should not be treated as a uniformly beneficial default. Instead, adaptation strategies should begin with a careful assessment of the base model's existing competence, accompanied by source-level data analysis and task-level evaluation.
items.title_ko: 연속 사전 훈련은 언제 도움이 되는가? 퀘벡 프랑스어 방언 적응에 대한 통제 연구
items.summary_ko: 연속 사전 훈련(CPT)은 사전 훈련된 언어 모델을 방언 및 비표준 언어 변형에 적응시키는 데 널리 사용되지만, 이러한 추가 훈련이 언제 필요한지, 그 이점이 무엇인지, 그리고 집계된 평가 점수가 그 효과를 적절하게 포착하는지는 불분명합니다. 이 연구는 9가지 LLM에 걸쳐 퀘벡 프랑스어 이해에 대한 CPT의 통제 연구를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM을 특정 언어 또는 방언에 적응시키는 전략에 대한 중요한 통찰을 제공하여, 모델의 실제 적용 가능성과 성능을 향상시키는 데 도움을 줍니다.

items.title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
items.body: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference states through on-policy exploration. On ALFWorld and WebShop, our method outperforms competitive agentic RL methods at both model scales, achieving success rates of 90.1%/96.1% and 80.2%/82.6% with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct, respectively.
items.title_ko: 깊이 우선 탐색: LLM 에이전트를 위한 장점 분해를 통한 역방향-정방향 커리큘럼
items.summary_ko: 강화 학습은 장기 작업에서 LLM 에이전트를 훈련하는 일반적인 접근 방식이지만, 희소한 터미널 보상으로 인해 신용 할당 및 탐색이 어렵습니다. 이 연구는 정책 유도 역량 영역(policy-induced capability region)과 장점 분해를 통해 이러한 문제를 해결하는 역방향-정방향 커리큘럼 학습 방식을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트가 복잡한 장기 작업을 효율적으로 학습하는 방법을 제시하여, AI 에이전트의 성능과 학습 효율성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 실용적인 기술입니다.

items.title: Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
items.body: Malicious adversaries can employ gradient inversion attacks to reverse-engineer private data using the model updates of a round in Federated Learning. While there have been developments in gradient inversion for text, exact text recovery by a malicious client has so far remained infeasible, as FedAvg entangles the gradient contributions of many clients and obscures the signal of any individual sentence. We introduce a novel attack pipeline that unwinds this entanglement progressively through an iterative loop, in which the gradient contributions of sentences recovered exactly in one round are subtracted from the aggregate, exposing the remaining sentences for recovery in the next iteration. We show, for the first time, exact sentence recovery, with 100% precision, and on aggregates containing up to $4\times$ more tokens than the model's hidden dimension, we recover up to 80.2% of client sentences exactly, a regime where existing attacks recover none exactly.

items.title: Movie2Game-Bench: Holistic Evaluation of Film-to-Game Adaptation Beyond Playability
items.body: Adapting a film into a game requires selecting source elements and translating them into player actions, rules, and feedback. We introduce Movie2Game-Bench (M2G-bench), a benchmark for evaluating film-to-game adaptation beyond playability. M2G-bench combines general evaluation, movie-specific evaluation, and playtesting by three GUI model players. The protocol connects source content to gameplay steps and implementation evidence, capturing both content preservation and interactive realization. The benchmark comprises 22 films and 658 source-specific reference items. Evaluating 14 models on the same films with their selected primary harnesses reveals complementary strengths in game quality, adaptation, and player experience. A shared weakness concerns playable sequences: this category has the lowest content-presence mean in all 14 models, averaging 37.9 out of 100 compared with 54.8 for iconic elements. Among judgments of retained emotionaldevelopment content, narrative choices account for 60.0% and scenario operation for 7.2%. These findings identify two linked priorities for film-to-game adaptation: preserving source situations that can support gameplay and connecting retained content to player actions and consequences.
items.title_ko: Movie2Game-Bench: 플레이 가능성을 넘어선 영화-게임 각색의 전체론적 평가
items.summary_ko: 영화를 게임으로 각색하려면 원본 요소를 선택하고 이를 플레이어 동작, 규칙 및 피드백으로 변환해야 합니다. Movie2Game-Bench(M2G-bench)는 플레이 가능성을 넘어선 영화-게임 각색을 평가하기 위한 벤치마크를 소개합니다. 이 프로토콜은 원본 콘텐츠를 게임 플레이 단계 및 구현 증거와 연결하여 콘텐츠 보존과 인터랙티브 구현을 모두 포착합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용한 콘텐츠 생성 및 변환의 품질을 객관적으로 평가하는 것은 중요합니다. M2G-bench는 영화-게임 각색과 같은 복잡한 AI 응용 프로그램의 성능을 측정하는 새로운 표준을 제시합니다.

items.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
items.body: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
items.title_ko: CurvDelta: 수술 학습 및 학습 취소를 위한 저곡률 델타 모델링
items.summary_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 적응의 주요 과제는 능력 보존입니다. CurvDelta는 모델 업데이트의 매개변수화에 보존 제약을 통합하는 확장 가능한 프레임워크를 소개합니다. 이는 사전 적응 모델 주변의 보존 제약의 로컬 기하학을 분석하여, 매개변수 업데이트가 보존 손실을 거의 변화시키지 않는 저곡률 공간을 구성합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM을 특정 작업에 맞게 미세 조정할 때 기존 능력이 저하되는 '재앙적 망각' 문제를 해결하는 중요한 방법론으로, 모델 적응의 효율성과 안정성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
items.body: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
items.body_ko: 저희는 Agentic Data Engineering 및 재귀적 자체 개선(RSI)을 통해 모델 역량과 훈련 데이터를 공동으로 발전시키는 멀티모달 의사결정 모델 제품군인 Piccolo(0.8B에서 27B)를 소개합니다. 이 모델들은 범용 텍스트 및 시각적 판단, 에이전트 하네스, 데이터 워크플로우, 대화형 게임에 대한 후보 답변의 확률을 예측합니다. Piccolo-27B는 75.59점으로 Decision Index Vision Full 리더보드에서 1위를 차지했으며, Piccolo-9B와 Piccolo-4B는 각각 68.35점과 67.46점을 기록했습니다. 세 모델 모두 해당 모델 크기 범주에서 Private 벤치마크에서 1위를 차지했습니다. 연구 에이전트는 모델 동작을 분석하고, 훈련 데이터를 구성하고, 실험을 수행하며, 그 결과를 사용하여 후속 제안을 개선합니다. 시맨틱 슬라이스와 공유 연구 메모리는 모델 제품군 개발 전반에 걸쳐 이러한 작업을 연결합니다. 수십만 개의 예제로 구성된 훈련 레시피를 통해 데이터 선택 및 피드백 기반 개선은 자체 개선 프로세스의 핵심입니다. 우리의 대규모 RSI 탐색은 의사결정 모델 개발에 대한 세 가지 직관에 반하는 통찰력을 제공합니다: (1) 백본-레시피 공동 적응이 순수 모델 최신성보다 중요합니다: 동일한 레시피 하에서 이전 백본이 시각적 작업에서 새로운 세대를 능가할 수 있습니다; (2) 타겟팅된 데이터 큐레이션은 4B-9B 모델이 전문화된 워크플로우에서 27B 기준 모델과 경쟁할 수 있도록 합니다; 그리고 (3) 지속적인 손실 감소는 이산적 의사결정 정확도와 분리될 수 있으며 심지어 저하시킬 수도 있습니다. Data-Juicer 및 AgentScope 생태계에서 공개된 가중치 및 도구와 함께 Piccolo는 프론티어 의사결정 모델을 구축하고 데이터 기반 RSI를 확장하기 위한 실행 가능한 청사진을 제공합니다.
items.title_ko: Piccolo: 재귀적 자가 개선을 통한 의사결정 모델과 데이터의 공동 진화
items.summary_ko: Piccolo는 에이전트 기반 데이터 엔지니어링 및 재귀적 자가 개선(RSI)을 통해 모델 역량과 훈련 데이터를 공동 진화시키는 멀티모달 의사결정 모델(0.8B~27B) 제품군입니다. Piccolo-27B는 Decision Index Vision Full 리더보드에서 75.59점으로 1위를 차지했으며, Piccolo-9B와 Piccolo-4B도 높은 점수를 기록했습니다.
items.why_ko: 자가 개선형 AI 모델의 최신 성과를 보여주며, 멀티모달 의사결정 분야에서 최고 수준의 성능을 달성하여 AI 에이전트의 발전 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
items.body: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.
items.title_ko: 소규모 언어 모델의 더 나은 의료 설명을 위한 자가 보상 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 소규모 언어 모델(SLM)은 온프레미스 배포가 가능하지만, 대규모 언어 모델에 비해 의료 설명이 짧고 구조화되지 않은 경우가 많습니다. 이 연구는 Mistral-7B 백본을 기반으로 자가 보상 강화 학습을 사용하여 SLM의 의료 설명 구조와 스타일을 직접 개선하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 엣지 AI와 개인 정보 보호가 중요한 의료 분야에서 SLM의 활용성을 높이는 동시에, 설명의 품질을 향상시켜 의료 전문가와 환자에게 더 유용하고 신뢰할 수 있는 정보를 제공할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
items.body: Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations. We extend this framework to constrained zonotopes, which add linear constraints to tighten bounds, and derive sound quantization error representations. We establish soundness and affine-strip optimality of the round-clamp abstract transformer, as well as convex-hull optimality of its complete constrained formulation. On the ACAS Xu benchmarks, our constrained zonotope method reduces average error-bound widths by approximately 70-85% and runtimes by 65-80% compared to QEBVerif's symbolic DRA propagation at the two smallest tested perturbation radii (r=3 and r=6). These improvements are not uniform across bitwidths, and symbolic DRA achieves tighter bounds at larger radii. Our plain zonotope method delivers competitive sound bounds nearly 300 times faster on average.
items.title_ko: 신경망 양자화 오류의 Zonotopic 분석
items.summary_ko: 양자화된 신경망은 정밀도를 낮춰 계산 효율성을 달성하지만, 이산적인 반올림 및 클램핑 작업으로 인해 양자화 오류를 경계하는 것이 어렵습니다. 이 연구는 zonotope 기반의 추상 해석 프레임워크를 제시하며, 양자화된 ReLU 피드포워드 네트워크 검증을 위한 통합된 round-clamp 추상 변환기를 도입합니다.
items.why_ko: 엣지 디바이스 및 저전력 환경에서 AI 모델을 효율적으로 배포하기 위한 양자화 기술의 정확성을 보장하는 데 중요한 연구입니다.

items.title: Equal Steps, Unequal Curvature: Where Muon's Update Goes Wrong
items.body: Muon updates each hidden weight matrix along the polar factor of its momentum, the steepest-descent direction under the spectral norm. That choice fixes two allocations without consulting the loss: every singular direction of the momentum receives the same step, and in a non-square matrix each neuron's step is set by its leverage score. Whether they are good is a question about curvature, which steepest-descent arguments do not answer; we measure it. Using held-out gradients and Hessian-vector products, we decompose Muon's step by singular-value band and by neuron group and compute each group's second-order optimal multiplier. In a 124M-parameter decoder trained on FineWeb-Edu, the multipliers rise monotonically from the top singular directions to the tail: Muon over-steps the high-curvature top of its spectrum. We prove in Lean when such a diagnostic licenses an intervention at Muon's own update norm. On the measured curvature, the criterion predicts, and held-out losses confirm, that moving step length off the top helps mid-training and early in the cooldown, but not at its end. We then test interventions under per-step norm matching, tuned baselines and paired seeds. Orthogonalizing Q, K and V separately rather than as one fused matrix lowers the loss by 0.0250 nats and accounts for all of the gain of block-wise variants. A matmul-only, rotation-equivariant spectral tilt $σ^{-1/4}$ applied in the cooldown lowers the loss of this stronger baseline by a further 0.0120 nats, additively with NorMuon (0.0158 nats together, three seeds; the baseline needs about 4.3% more tokens to match), and by 0.0188 nats at 355M parameters (three seeds). Energy-matched Schatten-1 weight decay adds a further 0.0052 nats. Geometrically principled changes that do not act on the measured miscalibration, namely exact polar factors, steepest-descent input whitening and top-heavy decay, do not help.
items.title_ko: 균등한 스텝, 불균등한 곡률: Muon 업데이트의 문제점
items.summary_ko: Muon은 각 숨겨진 가중치 행렬을 모멘텀의 극 인수를 따라 업데이트합니다. 이 연구는 이러한 선택이 손실을 고려하지 않고 두 가지 할당을 고정하며, 각 뉴런의 스텝이 레버리지 점수에 의해 설정되는 방식이 곡률에 대한 질문을 남긴다고 주장합니다. 이 연구는 이를 측정합니다.
items.why_ko: 딥러닝 최적화 알고리즘의 동작을 깊이 이해하고 개선하는 데 필요한 이론적 분석을 제공합니다. 이는 모델 학습의 안정성과 효율성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
items.body: Multimodal language models for materials science rely on effective mechanisms for incorporating three-dimensional structural representations. MatterChat addresses this challenge using a large bridge module between a pretrained structural encoder and the LLM, together with a separate contrastive alignment stage. We instead ask whether this bridge can adaptively select and combine representations from multiple structural encoders according to the target property. We find that supervised and generative material encoders provide complementary information for property prediction. We found that, for Zatom-1, this information is not concentrated in the final layer. Instead, the most informative representations occur at different depths depending on the target property. This motivates Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF), a lightweight attention-based bridge that uses task-conditioned latent queries to combine CHGNet features with intermediate Zatom-1 representations. The bridge is trained directly on downstream prediction tasks, allowing representation selection and material-language alignment to be learned jointly without separate contrastive pretraining. Across classification and regression tasks, TCAF outperforms MatterChat, with up to 47.8% lower RMSE, while using substantially fewer trainable parameters and halving the overall training time. Further experiments incorporating UMA-S demonstrate TCAF's flexibility across encoder combinations, with the three-encoder configuration achieving the highest macro-average classification accuracy of 89.61%.
items.title_ko: 올바른 표현 선택: 멀티모달 재료 언어 모델을 위한 작업 인식 융합
items.summary_ko: 재료 과학을 위한 멀티모달 언어 모델은 3차원 구조 표현을 효과적으로 통합하는 메커니즘에 의존합니다. MatterChat은 사전 훈련된 구조 인코더와 LLM 사이에 큰 브릿지 모듈을 사용하지만, 이 연구는 대상 속성에 따라 여러 구조 인코더의 표현을 적응적으로 선택하고 결합할 수 있는지 질문합니다.
items.why_ko: 멀티모달 AI 모델이 다양한 데이터 유형(특히 3D 구조 데이터)을 통합하고 특정 과학적 작업에 맞게 최적화하는 방법을 탐구하여, 재료 과학 분야에서 AI의 응용 가능성을 확장합니다.

items.title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
items.body: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.
items.title_ko: Hypnos: 엣지에서의 확장 가능한 연속 학습을 위한 듀얼 페이즈 엔드투엔드 플랫폼
items.summary_ko: 연속 학습(CL)은 신경망이 비정상 데이터 스트림에 적응하도록 하여 치명적인 망각을 완화하고 견고하고 사적이며 적응 가능한 엣지 장치로 가는 길을 제공합니다. Hypnos는 온라인 작업 및 엣지 장치의 낮은 설치 공간이라는 두 가지 과제를 해결하기 위한 듀얼 페이즈 엔드투엔드 플랫폼을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 엣지 디바이스에서 AI 모델의 지속적인 학습과 적응을 가능하게 하는 실용적인 솔루션으로, IoT 및 자율 시스템 분야에서 AI의 활용도를 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
items.body: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and a separate, zero-initialized right-context convolution branch. Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, it reaches a reported generation speed of 680 tokens/s using one NVIDIA GB300 GPU at BF16 precision and batch size one. We organize the evaluation around model quality, drafting and verification costs, and deployment under constrained memory. We also describe a decision-model variant that generates answers to related questions in one denoising pass. On an internal set of 500 groups, joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%.
items.title_ko: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 기술 보고서
items.summary_ko: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview(Clover)는 350억 개의 총 매개변수와 30억 개의 활성화된 매개변수를 가진 전문가 혼합(mixture-of-experts) 확산 언어 모델입니다. Clover는 Gated Delta Networks를 적용하여 이전에 생성된 컨텍스트의 순환 메모리와 현재 블록 내부의 양방향 소프트맥스 어텐션을 결합하여 블록 확산을 차단하고, 사고 모드 생성을 지원합니다.
items.why_ko: 새로운 대규모 확산 언어 모델이 '사고 모드 생성'을 지원한다는 점에서 LLM의 추론 및 생성 능력 발전에 대한 기대를 높입니다. MoE 아키텍처와 메모리 메커니즘의 결합은 효율성과 성능 개선에 중요한 시사점을 제공합니다.

items.title: H3Remover: Reinforcing Video Object Removal without Paired Data
items.body: Pretrained video editors possess rich removal and completion priors, yet may retain targets or alter unrelated content. We present H3Remover, which reinforces MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA for video object removal without paired object-free training targets. To discourage superficial edits such as recoloring, a target-removal reward favors calibrated depth changes consistent with revealing farther content. To limit unintended scene changes, a background-geometry reward encourages preservation of relative depth ordering. To preserve background appearance without retaining unwanted shadows or reflections, an appearance reward constrains RGB changes in source-derived protected regions while exempting targets and estimated effects. Frozen HPSv3 complements these constraints with perceptual-quality feedback for synthesized content. Evaluation regions remain fixed across candidates, and DiffusionART optimizes LoRA adapters with the backbone frozen. Experiments show substantial reconstruction gains over original H3, with qualitative comparisons demonstrating more effective object removal and better preservation of surrounding scene content.
items.title_ko: H3Remover: 페어링된 데이터 없이 비디오 객체 제거 강화
items.summary_ko: 사전 훈련된 비디오 편집기는 풍부한 제거 및 완성 사전 지식을 가지고 있지만, 대상 객체를 유지하거나 관련 없는 콘텐츠를 변경할 수 있습니다. H3Remover는 페어링된 객체 없는 훈련 대상 없이 MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA를 비디오 객체 제거를 위해 강화합니다. 이는 제거 보상과 배경 기하학 보상을 통해 작동합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 편집 및 생성 분야에서 AI 모델의 정교함을 높이는 중요한 연구입니다. 특히 페어링되지 않은 데이터로 객체 제거 성능을 향상시키는 것은 실제 적용에 큰 이점이 있습니다.

items.title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
items.body: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
items.title_ko: 인간 뇌 조직 분석을 언어 모델에 전이
items.summary_ko: 인간 피질 발달 과정에서 기능 시스템은 점점 더 분화됩니다. 이 연구는 언어 모델의 추론 능력 향상도 유사한 지역적 재조직을 포함하는지 질문했습니다. 확산 맵 임베딩을 사용하여 세 가지 LLM 계열의 일치하는 기본 모델과 추론 훈련 모델에 적용한 결과, 연속적인 계층 범위 내에서 국지적인 변화와 함께 대체로 보존된 기울기 프로필을 발견했습니다.
items.why_ko: 인간 뇌 기능과 LLM의 내부 작동 방식 간의 연관성을 탐구하여, AI 모델이 어떻게 지능을 발달시키는지에 대한 이해를 깊게 합니다.

items.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Location Encoding Methods for Species Distribution Modelling
items.body: Understanding the spatial distribution of species is a key question in ecology. A variety of solutions, from statistical, traditional machine learning, through to deep learning-based methods have been proposed. These methods take sparse observations for a species of interest as input and aim to generate dense spatial outputs indicating the spatial range of the species. Orthogonal to the choice of statistical model used is the question of what input features are most informative. Thanks to recent developments, the number of options has greatly expanded, with choices spanning different climate variables, learning-based encodings, earth embedding models, or raw transformed geographic coordinates. In this work, we introduce a standardized evaluation framework and quantify the effectiveness of different location encodings in the context of species range estimation, both at the local and global scale.
items.title_ko: 종 분포 모델링을 위한 위치 인코딩 방법의 효과 평가
items.summary_ko: 종의 공간 분포를 이해하는 것은 생태학의 핵심 질문입니다. 이 연구는 종 분포 모델링을 위해 다양한 통계, 전통적인 머신러닝, 딥러닝 기반 방법론과 함께, 어떤 입력 특징이 가장 정보성이 높은지에 대한 위치 인코딩 방법의 효과를 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 생태학 분야의 전문 연구로, AI 개발자의 실무에 직접적인 관련성은 적습니다.

items.title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
items.body: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. For efficient deployment, GateWatchServe computes only selected SAE features, enables streaming of their binary values across layers during inference, and evaluates multiple GateWatch classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables. Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch achieves 80.49% mean test accuracy using only 3.8 SAE features and 3.5 logic gates per probe on average, just 1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes, while matching or outperforming them on 10 tasks and reducing probe memory by 99.98%. Inside vLLM, 1,000 concurrent multi-layer, multi-token GateWatch classifiers retain 97-98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.
items.title_ko: GateWatch: 불리언 회로를 이용한 저오버헤드 LLM 모니터링
items.summary_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 및 LLM 기반 에이전트가 배포됨에 따라, 안전하지 않거나 의도하지 않은 행동을 감지하기 위한 모니터링이 중요해지고 있습니다. GateWatch는 불리언 회로를 사용하여 낮은 오버헤드로 LLM의 동작을 모니터링하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 안전성 및 신뢰성 확보를 위한 모니터링 기술은 AI 시스템의 실제 적용에 필수적입니다. GateWatch는 효율적인 모니터링을 통해 LLM의 오작동 및 악용을 방지하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Negotiating Control and Accountability among Stakeholders in High-Risk AI Use Cases: Development and Evaluation of the Method ALIGN
items.body: Characteristics of Artificial Intelligence (AI) severely restrict human control. This creates new challenges for socio-technical systems design especially in safety-critical domains, where control over risks is essential along with the accountability for any harm caused. Drawing from human factors and AI governance literature, expert interviews and participant observation in a complex high-risk AI use case from the railways, we developed ALIGN, a scenario-based method that supports the governance of and stakeholder involvement in AI development and implementation in three ways: raising awareness for potential accountability-control misalignments in socio-technical systems and their negative consequences, offering a structured approach to assessing the alignment between accountability and control for stakeholders in a given use case, and supporting effective design decisions to mitigate AI risks. We describe the iterative development and evaluation of ALIGN and discuss how this method promotes AI governance by highlighting the relevance of control-accountability alignment throughout the AI life cycle.
items.title_ko: 고위험 AI 활용 사례에서 이해관계자 간의 통제 및 책임 협상: ALIGN 방법론 개발 및 평가
items.summary_ko: AI의 특성은 인간의 통제를 심각하게 제한하여, 특히 안전에 중요한 영역에서 위험 통제 및 책임 문제에 대한 새로운 과제를 야기합니다. ALIGN은 시나리오 기반 방법론으로, 철도와 같은 복잡한 고위험 AI 활용 사례에서 AI 거버넌스를 지원하여 이해관계자 간의 통제 및 책임 협상을 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: 고위험 AI 시스템의 책임 소재와 통제 메커니즘을 확립하는 것은 AI 윤리 및 거버넌스의 핵심입니다. ALIGN은 이러한 복잡한 문제를 해결하기 위한 실용적인 프레임워크를 제공합니다.

items.title: Diffusion Models are Provably Efficient Priors for Sparse Recovery
items.body: Diffusion models have transformed generative modeling through their ability to capture and generate samples from complex data distributions. This success has spurred substantial interest in using pretrained diffusion models as expressive priors for highly ill-posed inverse problems in imaging and sensing. Despite strong empirical performance, theoretical understanding of this approach remains limited: existing guarantees are often asymptotic or entail prohibitive computational costs in the worst case. In this paper, we address this gap by studying sparse recovery from a small number of linear measurements, a classical problem in compressed sensing. We show that, given an accurate diffusion model capturing a sparsity-promoting Bernoulli-Gaussian prior, a likelihood-guided annealed Langevin sampler provably recovers the sparse signal in polynomial time with near-optimal sample complexity for a broad family of random and deterministic sensing matrices. When the signal is indeed drawn from the postulated prior, we further establish total variation guarantees for posterior sampling after a final denoising step. These results lay a theoretical foundation for statistically and computationally efficient inverse solvers with diffusion priors.
items.title_ko: 확산 모델은 희소 복구를 위한 효율적인 사전 모델임이 입증 가능
items.summary_ko: 확산 모델은 복잡한 데이터 분포에서 샘플을 포착하고 생성하는 능력으로 생성 모델링을 변화시켰습니다. 이 연구는 사전 훈련된 확산 모델을 이미징 및 센싱의 심하게 비정규화된 역문제에 대한 표현력 있는 사전 모델로 사용하는 것에 대한 이론적 이해가 부족하다고 지적하며, 확산 모델이 희소 복구를 위한 효율적인 사전 모델임을 증명합니다.
items.why_ko: 확산 모델의 이론적 기반을 강화하고, 이미지 복원 등 역문제 해결에 확산 모델을 더욱 효과적으로 활용할 수 있는 방법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA) for Plant Spectroscopy
items.body: Plant reflectance spectroscopy across the visible, near-infrared, and shortwave infrared domain encodes foliar biochemical and anatomical traits into contiguous spectral signatures with locally differentiable structure; however, extreme inter-band collinearity and unfavorable sample-to-feature ratios challenge predictive modeling. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods routinely adopted in spectroscopy, are column-permutation invariant: they treat adjacent wavelengths as unordered tabular columns and discard the sequential differential geometry of absorption features. Here, we propose Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA), a supervised dimensionality reduction operator that projects contiguous spectra into a compact morpho-spectral subspace through three complementary blocks: (i) additive continuum-removed absorption depth, area, and red-edge inflection kinematics; (ii) local multi-order singular eigenmodes (0th, 1st, and 2nd derivatives) partitioned across contiguous radiative sub-windows; and (iii) global Fisher-weighted canonical subspaces regularized via trace-normalized isotropic covariance shrinkage. We validated MSPA across 8,963 spectra spanning five plant systems, coupled with six classical machine learning classifiers and four Tabular Foundation Models (TabPFN v3, TabICL v2, TabDPT v1.2, and TabFM). Despite compressing the 1,580-band spectrum by 96%, MSPA outperformed the full spectrum in 92.0% of all benchmarks and conventional reducers in 90.0% of all model-crop evaluations, raising the global mean macro-F1 from 0.7756 (full spectrum) to 0.8520, accelerating in-context inference by up to 126.5x. Designed as a self-contained spectral projection operator, the MSPA method can be directly integrated into spectroscopy workflows via the open-source code available at GitHub: https://github.com/Lucas-Osco/mspa.
items.title_ko: 식물 분광학을 위한 형태-스펙트럼 투영 분석 (MSPA)
items.summary_ko: 가시광선, 근적외선, 단파 적외선 영역의 식물 반사 분광학은 엽면 생화학적 및 해부학적 특성을 연속적인 스펙트럼 신호로 인코딩합니다. 이 연구는 극심한 대역 간 공선성과 불리한 샘플 대 특징 비율이 예측 모델링에 도전 과제를 제기한다고 지적하며, MSPA 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 식물 생리학 및 농업 분야의 전문 연구 내용으로, AI 개발자의 실무에 직접적인 관련성은 적습니다.

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Hidden States Reveal Task-Solving Directions for Direct Answers
items.body: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the performance of Large Language Models by eliciting intermediate reasoning steps. However, CoT is far from perfect: on some tasks, models perform worse than with direct-answer prompting, and on others they generate a few hundred tokens to reach the correct answer. We start by labelling each CoT hidden state as recovering if patching it into the direct prompt yields the correct answer, and failed otherwise. A linear probe shows that the model encodes these two classes differently. We then show that the representation space of the direct prompt holds a direction for each question that leads the model, in a short generation, to the correct answer more often than CoT does. Specifically, we rotate the direct prompt's last hidden state once, before generation, towards a direction built for each question from its own recovering and failed states. Across 25 tasks, these directions raise the direct prompt's mean accuracy from $46\%$ to $85\%$ on LLaMA 3.1 8B (CoT: $69\%$) and from $52\%$ to $86\%$ on Qwen 2.5 7B (CoT: $77\%$), with a tenth of CoT's tokens.
