CoT is thus not the shortest route to this accuracy, and these directions can be used in future work to train models to align their states with them.
items.title_ko: CoT(Chain-of-Thought) 숨겨진 상태가 직접 답변을 위한 작업 해결 방향을 드러낸다
items.summary_ko: CoT(Chain-of-Thought) 프롬프팅은 중간 추론 단계를 유도하여 대규모 언어 모델의 성능을 향상시키지만 완벽하지 않습니다. 이 연구는 각 CoT 숨겨진 상태를 '복구' 또는 '실패'로 레이블링하고, 선형 프로브를 통해 모델이 태스크 해결 방향을 인코딩한다는 것을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 추론 과정을 깊이 이해하고 디버깅하는 데 중요한 연구입니다. CoT의 내부 작동을 분석하여 모델 성능을 개선하고, 잘못된 추론을 수정하는 데 실질적인 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

items.title: From Activity Recognition to Shift Detection: Variational Wi-Fi Sensing with Evidential Uncertainty
items.body: Human motion perturbs wireless channels, making commodity Wi-Fi devices a practical platform for device-free activity recognition. Yet Channel State Information (CSI) also depends strongly on the person, receiver position, recording session, and surrounding environment, so a classifier can continue producing activity labels after its deployment conditions have moved away from those seen during training. We propose Wi-HAR, a multi-antenna architecture in which four Variational Auto-Encoders learn compact distributions from raw Wi-Fi 6 CSI magnitudes and a delayed-fusion classifier combines their means and log-variances. On twelve activities from a public benchmark, Wi-HAR reaches 96.6% median recognition accuracy, compared with 70.8-81.5% for independently optimized single-antenna models, showing that the antennas provide complementary views of the same activity. We then use the same latent backbone to detect deployment shifts without using shifted samples for model selection or calibration. A class-conditional uncertainty score derived from Evidential Deep Learning achieves a macro-average ROC-AUC of 0.897 across eleven datasets that change receiver position, participant, recording session, or room, and detects 82.5% of shifted samples at a realized 5.2% in-distribution rejection rate. Detection performance nevertheless varies substantially across receiver positions, showing that the same physical change does not induce a uniform uncertainty response. The compact representation also supports shallow decision-tree analysis using variables from several antennas.
items.title_ko: 활동 인식에서 변화 탐지까지: 증거적 불확실성을 이용한 변분 Wi-Fi 감지
items.summary_ko: 인간의 움직임은 무선 채널을 방해하여 Wi-Fi 장치를 장치 없는 활동 인식을 위한 실용적인 플랫폼으로 만듭니다. Wi-HAR은 4개의 변분 자동 인코더가 학습한 다중 안테나 아키텍처로, 배포 조건이 훈련 시와 달라진 후에도 분류기가 활동 레이블을 계속 생성하는 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: Wi-Fi 신호를 이용한 비접촉식 활동 감지는 스마트 홈, 헬스케어 등 다양한 분야에서 잠재력이 큽니다. 이 연구는 환경 변화에 강건한 AI 모델을 개발하여 실제 적용 가능성을 높입니다.

items.title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
items.body: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. Improving the controller's weights on a single game, by contrast, yields only modest gains. These results favor letting a model think offline and storing what it learns in a program that acts in real time. Project repository: https://github.com/TabibitoQZP/SIGame
items.title_ko: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: 코드를 통한 자가 개선 시각 게임 에이전트
items.summary_ko: 사전 훈련된 모델은 화면을 읽고 게임에 대해 추론할 수 있지만, 낯선 게임에서는 여전히 플레이 방법을 배워야 합니다. 이 연구는 실시간 시각 게임에서 에이전트가 자신의 시도를 통해 실시간으로 자가 개선하는 방법을 탐구합니다. '모델을 정책으로'와 '코드 생성'이라는 두 가지 정책 유형을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 실시간 환경에서 AI 에이전트의 자율 학습 및 자가 개선 능력은 범용 AI 에이전트 개발에 핵심적입니다. 코드를 통해 학습하는 방식은 AI의 유연성과 적응성을 크게 향상시킬 잠재력을 가집니다.

items.title: Large Language Models or AI Agents for English to Arabic Translation? An assessment on WikiEn-Ar190
items.body: This research investigates whether a large language model or an autonomous AI Agent performs better at translating from English to Arabic, which is considered a low-resource language. The authors introduce WikiEn-Ar190, a new dataset of 190 carefully selected Wikipedia articles from 18 different areas, which were created and verified by two native Arabic speakers to ensure that they accurately reflect both meaning and style. Using this dataset, the study evaluates the translation quality of GPT-5-mini both as an independent neural translator and when used within a more complex process that includes self-assessment and improvement. As a standalone model, GPT-5-mini produced very fluent translations , achieving a COMET score of 0.8649 and receiving high human scores for adequacy, fluency, and style (averaging 4.53 out of 5). When used in a system that combined translation with self-assessment, it improved lexical accuracy by 28.76% (BLEU score of 22.83) while maintaining a similar level of semantic quality. These findings show that methods involving autonomous reasoning can improve translation consistency for language pairs with limited resources. Beyond the results, the approach offers a framework for evaluating and improving translations, potentially using them as assisting tools to expand the representation of low resource languages, such as Arabic, on the web.
items.title_ko: LLM 및 AI 에이전트의 영어-아랍어 번역 성능 비교 연구 (WikiEn-Ar190 데이터셋)
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 LLM과 AI 에이전트 중 어느 쪽이 저자원 언어인 영어-아랍어 번역에 더 뛰어난지 조사했습니다. 18개 분야에서 엄선된 위키백과 기사 190개로 구성된 새로운 데이터셋 WikiEn-Ar190을 구축하여 GPT 모델의 번역 품질을 평가했습니다.
items.why_ko: 저자원 언어 번역에 대한 LLM과 에이전트의 실제 성능을 비교하고, 새로운 고품질 평가 데이터셋을 제공하여 관련 연구에 기여합니다.

items.title: BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization
items.body: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is moving from the harness of prompts and tools around a base model toward the model itself. However, existing RSI still faces key challenges, including harness-bound gains that stay outside the base model, black-box supervision that reads only the model's outputs, and imprecise edits whose site and strength are fixed in advance. To address these challenges, we propose BaseRSI, a new paradigm of Recursive Harness Internalization: the base model improves its harness, then writes what the harness adds into its own weights through training-free edits, round after round on its own responses. To support this paradigm, we introduce ReGap, a mechanism that supervises every transformer block with the high-dimensional activation difference that the harness makes at that block alone, and updates the block's weights along this signal in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this mechanism, we further propose ReKey, an algorithm that writes this signal by regression into a few key-value neurons of every block, and measures the site and strength of each edit on the model's own responses. Moreover, the base model fills every role of this recursion with forward passes alone, and its edits, written at different sites, compose in one checkpoint without refitting. Experimental results on ten visual reasoning benchmarks show that BaseRSI consistently improves a base vision-language model both in distribution and on held-out benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/BaseRSI.
items.title_ko: BaseRSI: 비전-언어 모델의 재귀적 자체 개선을 위한 훈련 없는 내재화
items.summary_ko: BaseRSI는 비전-언어 모델의 재귀적 자체 개선(RSI)을 위한 새로운 패러다임을 제안합니다. 이 방법은 프롬프트나 외부 도구에 의존하지 않고, 모델 내부적으로 '하네스' 기능을 내재화하여 모델 자체의 성능을 향상시키는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 모델이 외부적인 도움 없이 스스로 성능을 개선하는 방향으로 나아가는 것은 궁극적인 AI 발전 방향과 맞닿아 있으며, 이는 모델의 자율성 증대와 효율성 향상에 중요한 의미를 가집니다.

items.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
items.body: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. We study the opposite strategy, late entry, where new tokens skip initial passes and enter directly into the final K < T passes over a deep context cache. Once lightweight fine-tuning resolves hidden-state norm mismatch at the entry boundary, deep cached context substitutes for skipped token-local passes, allowing late entry to outperform matched early exit across model families and pass budgets. To turn this asymmetry into wall-clock speedups without stalling to build deep caches, candidate blocks verify through only the final K passes on the critical path while previously committed tokens complete passes 1 -> T alongside subsequent steps at zero extra serial calls. Projecting these finished T-pass wake states inside the existing output GEMM (Wake verification, governed by logit-margin tolerance tau in [0, inf]) unifies greedy-exact T-pass decoding (tau = 0, matching K = T block decoding within bf16 reduction order), margin-gated verification (tau > 0), and non-rollback lossy late entry (tau = inf) inside a single static CUDA graph. On Ouro-2.6B (T = 4), K = 2 Wake reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup at tau = 0 (+26% over K = 4 block decoding on GSM8K) and 6.8x at tau = inf (+16.9 points over trained early exit at matched speed). Scaling test-time recurrence across T in {8, 16, 32, 64} on Huginn-3.5B cuts K = T/4 rollbacks 21.5x with depth, driving greedy-exact (tau = 0) speedups to 6.1x (T = 32) and 8.4x (T = 64, +153% over K = 64 block) and tau = inf speedups to 10.6 to 12.5x.
items.title_ko: 루프형 언어 모델의 '늦은 진입' 전략 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 루프형 언어 모델에서 새로운 토큰이 초기 패스를 건너뛰고 심층 컨텍스트 캐시에 직접 진입하는 '늦은 진입(late entry)' 전략을 연구합니다. 이는 공유 계층 스택을 여러 번 반복하여 추론을 심화하는 루프형 모델의 디코딩 지연 문제를 해결하기 위한 접근 방식입니다.
items.why_ko: 루프형 언어 모델의 추론 속도와 효율성을 개선할 수 있는 새로운 디코딩 전략을 제안하여, 제한된 연산 자원으로 더 깊은 추론을 가능하게 하는 모델 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: AGAMOTTO: An AI-Enabled Framework for Time-Critical Tactical Course-of-Action Evaluation and Generation
items.body: Current command and control (C2) platforms lack integrated simulation capabilities that would allow commanders to dynamically explore courses of action (COAs) during live operations. This paper presents ongoing research and contributions to the development of AGAMOTTO (Advanced Guidance and Analytics for Military Operations, Tactical Threats, and Outcomes) as part of the overarching NGC2 program, which advances the Army's efforts to modernize C2 systems, such as the Tactical Assault Kit (TAK). The paper outlines the current design, preliminary findings, and the remaining research tasks, with an emphasis on how the completed work will support tactical decision-making in future time-constrained environments. While the full system is still under development, initial development and results demonstrate the feasibility of AGAMOTTO. Early experiments highlight both the potential benefits and practical constraints of deploying AI-enabled tools in operational settings, and introduce lessons learned and a viable training strategy to make AI-generated COAs feasible in tactical scenarios.
items.title_ko: AGAMOTTO: AI 기반 전술 작전 평가 및 생성 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: AGAMOTTO는 실시간 작전 중 지휘관이 동적으로 작전 계획(COA)을 탐색할 수 있도록 AI 기반 시뮬레이션 기능을 제공하는 프레임워크입니다. 이 연구는 미 육군의 차세대 지휘통제 시스템 현대화 노력의 일환으로, 전술 작전의 평가 및 생성 능력을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용하여 실시간으로 전술적 의사결정을 지원하는 것은 국방 분야에서 AI의 실질적인 적용 가능성을 보여주며, 복잡한 상황에서의 효율적인 작전 수행에 중요합니다.

items.title: Objective-Specialized Residual Streams in Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
items.body: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extend a Transformer's residual stream into multiple parallel streams with learned cross-stream connections. Prior work trains all streams toward a shared objective. We instead study whether assigning distinct learning objectives to different streams can improve task performance and induce objective-specific specialization. Using complementary lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval objectives as a test case, we find that objective-specialized mHC consistently outperforms a non-specialized mHC model across the full sparse--dense fusion range, for both two- and four-stream models and at two model scales. We then examine how specialization changes the model internally using probes of stream representations, residual mixing, objective-specific gradient flow, and read/write gates. The specialized and non-specialized models behave similarly through most of the network but diverge in the final layers: the specialized model develops increasingly objective-specific gradient flow, distinct read/write routing patterns, and reduced cross-stream mixing, and streams assigned to different objectives become increasingly dissimilar while those trained toward the same objective remain highly similar. Fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that the benefit stems from objective-specific read/write routing rather than learned cross-stream mixing. These results show that assigning distinct objectives to mHC streams can improve multi-objective retrieval while inducing structured, depth-dependent specialization in the residual computation.
items.title_ko: 다중 목적 함수를 가진 잔차 스트림을 통한 모델 특화 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 트랜스포머의 잔차 스트림을 여러 병렬 스트림으로 확장하고, 각 스트림에 고유한 학습 목적 함수를 할당하는 방식을 탐구합니다. 어휘적(희소) 및 의미론적(밀집) 검색 목적 함수를 사용하여, 이러한 방식이 작업 성능을 향상시키고 목적 함수별 특화를 유도할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 모델 내부에 여러 학습 목표를 부여하여 특정 기능에 특화된 스트림을 생성함으로써, 모델의 다재다능함과 효율성을 동시에 높일 수 있는 새로운 아키텍처 접근법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Taming the Tails of Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Interpolation Regime
items.body: In this paper, we study stochastic gradient descent in the smooth interpolation regime, where the population objective shares a common minimizer with the sample losses. In contrast to prior work, which has largely focused on in-expectation analysis, we obtain high-probability convergence guarantees under the same assumptions. In the convex case, we prove a fast rate of order $\log(β^{-1}) \cdot n^{-1}$ after $n$ iterations, with failure probability at most $β$. In the strongly convex case, we derive a family of moment-based bounds of order $β^{-p} \cdot \exp(-\mathcal{O}(p \cdot n))$ for $p \in (0,1]$, and complement them with a matching lower bound showing that the corresponding deterioration in the exponential rate is essentially unavoidable. In both settings, our theoretical results are unified across a broad class of step-size schedules. Building on this analysis, we extend our results to a low-noise regime and to nonconvex objectives satisfying the Polyak-Lojasiewicz condition.
items.title_ko: 보간 영역에서 확률적 경사 하강법의 꼬리 부분 제어
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 모집단 목적 함수가 표본 손실과 공통 최소값을 공유하는 매끄러운 보간 영역에서 확률적 경사 하강법(SGD)을 연구합니다. 기존의 기댓값 분석과 달리, 이 연구는 동일한 가정 하에 높은 확률 수렴 보장을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: SGD의 수렴 특성에 대한 보다 강력한 이론적 분석을 제공하여, 머신러닝 모델 학습의 안정성과 예측 가능성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: The geometry of neural network decision boundaries
items.body: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are built using well-understood mathematical operations, yet their complex nature poses significant challenges to intuitively understanding their decision-making processes. This work introduces a method for visualizing and measuring ANN decision boundary geometry directly in the high-dimensional input space, avoiding distortions found with traditional projection-based techniques. We analyze boundary curvatures and distances in diverse inputs, architectures, and training methods. Boundary distances grow smoothly and slowly with consistent curvature as the size of the subspace increases, suggesting that decision boundaries are close to input samples within large, continuous subspaces. We also quantify how much boundary distances and curvatures reduce near dataset samples after adversarial training. Training methodology has a significantly stronger impact on boundary distance and curvature than architecture or test-set accuracy. These findings are contextualized within prior work, supporting or refuting several previously proposed theories of boundary behavior. Our analytically and empirically supported methodology lays the foundation for future studies to improve network interpretability and understanding.
items.title_ko: 신경망 결정 경계의 기하학적 분석
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 인공 신경망(ANN)의 결정 경계 기하학을 고차원 입력 공간에서 직접 시각화하고 측정하는 방법을 제시합니다. 전통적인 투영 기반 기술에서 발생하는 왜곡을 피하며, 다양한 입력, 아키텍처, 그리고 학습 단계에서 결정 경계의 곡률과 거리를 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 신경망의 '블랙박스' 내부 작동을 더 잘 이해하고 해석할 수 있는 새로운 방법을 제시하여, 모델의 신뢰성과 디버깅 능력 향상에 도움을 줍니다.

items.title: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
items.body: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.
items.title_ko: NaviGATE: 멀티모달 지식 그래프 추론을 위한 잡음 인식 듀얼 뷰 생성
items.summary_ko: NaviGATE는 멀티모달 지식 그래프 추론(MKGR)의 과제를 해결하기 위해 잡음 인식 듀얼 뷰 생성 방식을 제안합니다. 기존 방법론의 한계를 극복하고, 관계형 구조, 텍스트 설명, 시각적 증거를 통합하여 누락된 사실을 추론하며, 잡음이 많은 검색에 취약하거나 유효하지 않은 엔티티를 생성하는 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 멀티모달 정보를 활용한 지식 그래프 추론의 정확도와 견고성을 향상시켜, 더욱 강력하고 신뢰할 수 있는 지식 기반 AI 시스템 구축에 기여합니다.

items.title: Do Frontier Model Ingredients Add Up? A Replicated Factorial Study of Small Language Models
items.body: Building a small language model requires choosing which published improvements to combine. We compare five changes in the same model, using the same data and training budget. We test selected combinations and repeat each one with a second random seed. Mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimisation and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid give the largest gains. Extra normalisation also helps, while an attention gate with a matched parameter budget adds little on average. The gains mostly combine, but small interactions between changes appear again in the repeated runs. Repetition also reveals benefits that an initial statistical estimate treated as noise. These findings apply to our small-model training setting; the expert models also have greater total capacity. The practical lesson is to test promising components together and repeat the comparisons before deciding which ones to keep.
items.body_ko: 소규모 언어 모델을 구축하려면 어떤 공개된 개선 사항을 결합할지 선택해야 합니다. 우리는 동일한 데이터와 훈련 예산을 사용하여 동일한 모델에서 다섯 가지 변경 사항을 비교합니다. 선택된 조합을 테스트하고, 각각을 두 번째 무작위 시드로 반복합니다. Mixture-of-experts 레이어, Muon 최적화 및 Gated DeltaNet 하이브리드가 가장 큰 이득을 제공합니다. 추가 정규화도 도움이 되며, 매칭된 매개변수 예산을 가진 어텐션 게이트는 평균적으로 거의 추가되지 않습니다. 이득은 대부분 결합되지만, 변경 사항 간의 작은 상호 작용이 반복 실행에서 다시 나타납니다. 반복은 또한 초기 통계적 추정치가 노이즈로 간주했던 이점을 드러냅니다. 이러한 결과는 우리의 소규모 모델 훈련 설정에 적용되며, 전문가 모델은 또한 더 큰 총 용량을 가집니다. 실제적인 교훈은 유망한 구성 요소를 함께 테스트하고, 어떤 것을 유지할지 결정하기 전에 비교를 반복하는 것입니다.
items.title_ko: 프론티어 모델 핵심 기술의 효과: 소규모 언어 모델의 요인 분석 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 소규모 언어 모델 구축 시 적용되는 여러 공개된 개선 사항들의 조합 효과를 분석합니다. Mixture-of-experts(MoE) 레이어, Muon 최적화, Gated DeltaNet 하이브리드가 가장 큰 성능 향상을 가져왔으며, 이러한 개선 사항들이 대체로 시너지를 낸다는 것을 발견했습니다.
items.why_ko: 소규모 언어 모델 개발자들이 제한된 자원으로 모델 성능을 극대화하기 위해 어떤 기술 조합이 효과적인지 실용적인 가이드를 제공하며, 이는 비용 효율적인 AI 개발에 중요합니다.

items.title: ProbMedTOD: A Bayesian Network Guided Task-Oriented Dialogue System for Patient History Taking
items.body:
Patient history taking is a strategic, multi-turn process that refines diagnostic hypotheses through iterative questioning, mirroring clinical reasoning where each inquiry updates beliefs over candidate diagnoses. Deploying AI in this setting is constrained by privacy, cost, and latency, making Small Language Models (SLMs) a more desirable backbone compared to larger LLMs. However, SLMs capture only the fast, intuitive "System 1" side of this process and lack explicit mechanisms for the deliberative "System 2" reasoning needed to maintain and update diagnostic uncertainty over time. Bayesian Networks (BayesNets) offer a natural complement, providing an interpretable framework for auditable probabilistic belief tracking. Yet, clinical BayesNets are difficult to construct due to their reliance on expert curated structure, dependencies, and parameters.
We introduce ProbMedTOD, which automatically synthesizes a clinical BayesNet from a small number of clinical notes in three stages: ontology building, structure prediction, and parameter estimation. ProbMedTOD then integrates the resulting BayesNet with SLMs, enabling probabilistic reasoning in multi-turn dialogues. A BayesNet Agent maintains real-time posterior distributions over diagnoses, while a Policy Agent picks diagnostically informative questions. Experiments on DDXPlus and MIMIC-IV Notes show that ProbMedTOD outperforms LLM-only and retrieval-based baselines, with especially strong gains for smaller models.
items.title_ko: ProbMedTOD: 베이지안 네트워크 기반 환자 병력 청취 태스크 지향 대화 시스템
items.summary_ko: ProbMedTOD는 환자 병력 청취를 위한 베이지안 네트워크 기반 태스크 지향 대화 시스템입니다. 소규모 언어 모델(SLM)을 활용하여 비용, 지연 시간, 개인 정보 보호 문제에 대응하며, 반복적인 질문을 통해 진단 가설을 정교화하는 임상 추론 과정을 모방합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 분야에서 SLM을 활용하여 개인 정보 보호와 효율성을 유지하면서도, 진단 정확도를 높일 수 있는 대화 시스템 개발의 가능성을 보여줍니다.

items.title: MECI: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction for Multimodal Entity Linking
items.body: Multimodal Entity Linking (MEL) aims to disambiguate mentions in multimodal contexts by grounding them to specific entities in a knowledge base. A pivotal challenge in MEL is capturing multi-level correspondences: the semantic consistency between mention-entity pairs and the complementary correlations across modalities. However, existing methods often suffer from element dominance due to their reliance on coupled interactions or coarse global aggregations. In response, we propose the Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction (MECI) framework. First, to capture multi-element mention-entity correspondences, we develop a Multi-view Experts Network that leverages a "divide-and-conquer" strategy for decoupled feature learning to mitigate element dominance, supported by a KL-guided routing mechanism that governs expert specialization and collaboration. Furthermore, to model cross-modal complementary correlations, we propose a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Module, where a dynamic modality-aware weighting network refines interactions across hierarchical semantic levels, thereby integrating multi-granular evidence to counteract element dominance. Finally, we incorporate a generative semantic refinement stage that utilizes large language models for zero-shot re-ranking. Extensive experiments on WikiDiverse, RichpediaMEL, and WikiMEL show that MECI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving Hits@1 by 1.95%, 7.30%, and 2.31%, respectively.
items.title_ko: MECI: 멀티모달 엔티티 연결을 위한 다중 요소 협력 상호작용
items.summary_ko: MECI(Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction)는 멀티모달 엔티티 연결(MEL)에서 다중 수준의 대응 관계를 포착하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 멘션-엔티티 쌍의 의미론적 일관성과 모달리티 간의 상호 보완적인 상관관계를 효과적으로 포착하여 기존 방법의 단점을 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 텍스트와 이미지 등 다양한 모달리티 정보를 통합하여 엔티티를 정확하게 연결하는 능력을 향상시켜, 검색, 질의응답 등 다양한 AI 애플리케이션의 성능을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
items.body: LLM-based artificial societies exhibit rich behavior but often lack scientific grounding: personas and environments are assumed, interaction networks are synthetic, and simulators are generated as free-form code, making results difficult to tie to real populations and sensitive to the backbone model. We argue that simulated worlds should be sampled from observed data, while simulation logic should be implemented by composing operations from a shared, task-independent vocabulary. In this paper, we introduce ABSClaw, a zero-code agent that compiles natural-language requests into executable, reality-grounded social simulations. ABSClaw grounds who acts, where they act, and with whom they interact in survey and census data, geospatial sources, and real networks. It expresses state transitions through 26 atomic operations. To support an open and extensible ecosystem, ABSClaw further allows capabilities to be added as lifecycle-scoped skills without modifying its core. Furthermore, we propose ABSBench, a benchmark of 193 real-world social-simulation tasks. On ABSBench, ABSClaw achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated social simulators. Three real-world case studies show that grounding personas, environments, and interaction networks each improves agreement with observed outcomes. With one runtime skill, ABSClaw executes 13 population-scale simulations, collectively involving 25 million agents. Together, these results demonstrate ABSClaw's real-world fidelity, extensibility, and scalability.
items.title_ko: ABSClaw: 가상 세계에서 현실 기반 사회 시뮬레이션으로
items.summary_ko: ABSClaw는 LLM 기반 인공 사회가 과학적 근거가 부족하다는 문제점을 지적하며, 관측된 데이터에서 시뮬레이션 세계를 샘플링하고 공유된, 태스크 독립적인 어휘로 시뮬레이션 로직을 구현할 것을 제안합니다. 이를 통해 현실과 연결된 사회 시뮬레이션을 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 기반 사회 시뮬레이션의 과학적 엄밀성을 높이고 현실 세계에 더 잘 적용할 수 있는 기반을 마련하여, 사회 현상 연구 및 예측의 정확도를 개선할 잠재력이 있습니다.

items.title: Sparse designs via quantization of the uniform measure on high-dimensional hypercubes
items.body: While the notions of sphere packing and sphere covering underlie the most widely used criteria for space-filling design in computer experiments, namely, the maximin and minimax approaches, they suffer from major drawbacks in high dimensions. First, when the dimension $d$ is very large, deploying a space-filling design requires an extremely large number of design points, making the very notion of a space-filling design questionable. Second, these two design characteristics are highly sensitive to boundaries, particularly when the design domain is a hypercube (the case considered in this paper), and especially to its vertices. This sensitivity is particularly acute when the design size is less than $2^d$. Instead of considering the maximin or minimax criterion, we consider here the quantization error of the uniform measure on the hypercube. This error has three key advantages: it accounts for the entire distribution of distances from a random point $U$ to the design, is less sensitive to boundary effects than the maximin and minimax criteria, and, thanks to Zador's celebrated theorem, enables a smooth and natural transition to uniform designs as the design size tends to infinity. Building on recent results on the construction of optimal random quantizers for spherically symmetric distributions (arXiv:2610.11772) we propose a method to generate random designs of a given target size $n$ with small $L_s$-mean quantization error. The support of the resulting distribution is then used to construct designs, possibly incrementally, with sizes up to $n$. We demonstrate that, for moderate $n$, designs supported on a fractional factorial subset of the vertices of a small hypercube perform exceptionally well---and significantly better than designs uniformly distributed over the entire hypercube. We also explain how to account for projections onto lower-dimensional subspaces.
items.title_ko: 고차원 하이퍼큐브의 균일 측정 양자화를 통한 희소 설계
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 고차원에서 공간 채움 설계의 주요 단점을 해결하기 위해 하이퍼큐브의 균일 측정 양자화를 통한 희소 설계를 연구합니다. 높은 차원에서는 매우 많은 설계점이 필요하다는 문제와 설계 특성이 이상치에 매우 민감하다는 문제를 다룹니다.
items.why_ko: 고차원 데이터 분석 및 실험 설계에서 효율적이고 견고한 표본 추출 방법을 제시하여, 머신러닝 모델의 학습 데이터 선정이나 시뮬레이션 설계에 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: The Largest Tractable Subclass of Multi-Scale Allen Temporal Reasoning
items.body: In this paper, we propose a novel model for temporal reasoning over multi-scale intervals. We show that this model yields a complete reasoning framework and exhibits other particularly interesting properties. Furthermore, we identify the maximal tractable subalgebra for this model, as well as for the other complete model, in the qualitative scales context, which exhibits weaker properties but whose results can be derived by transfer from our new model.
items.title_ko: 멀티스케일 앨런 시간 추론의 가장 다루기 쉬운 서브클래스
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 멀티스케일 간격에 대한 시간 추론을 위한 새로운 모델을 제안하고, 이 모델이 완전한 추론 프레임워크를 제공하며 흥미로운 특성을 가진다는 것을 보여줍니다. 또한 이 모델과 다른 완전한 모델에 대한 최대 다루기 쉬운 서브대수(subalgebra)를 식별합니다.
items.why_ko: 시간 정보를 다루는 AI 시스템의 추론 능력과 효율성을 향상시키는 이론적 기반을 제공하여, 시퀀스 데이터 분석이나 계획 수립과 같은 분야에 적용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Harvesting Expert-Parallel Bubbles for Fine-Tuning
items.body:
GPUs are expensive, yet latency-critical large language model (LLM) inference leaves part of them idle. Colocation reclaims this capacity by running best-effort work, such as fine-tuning, alongside serving. Many leading LLMs now use a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which adds a new source of idle time. Under expert parallelism, MoE experts are spread across GPUs, and because the router sends uneven numbers of tokens to each GPU, lightly loaded GPUs wait for the most loaded one. Even after applying load balancing solutions, such bubbles still take 8--13% of prefill time.
We present BubbleTea, the first colocation system that leverages expert-parallel bubbles for fine-tuning. Unlike existing colocation systems, which make one scheduling decision for all GPUs per forward pass, BubbleTea predicts each GPU's bubble at every layer from the router's token assignment, and fills it with short chunks of fine-tuning work that reuse the weights already loaded for serving. We also introduce compiler passes that automatically derive these chunks from the served LLM as-is, without porting each model architecture to a separate training engine.
Our evaluation on three MoE models, served on four A100 GPUs, shows that fine-tuning throughput with BubbleTea is 1.9--6.2$\times$ faster than with LLMStation, a state-of-the-art colocation system. BubbleTea keeps p90 inference latency within 10% of serving alone in 50 of 63 workloads, compared to 44 for LLMStation. On bursty production traces, BubbleTea trains 3.3$\times$ faster than LLMStation and 14$\times$ faster than a stock trainer colocated under CUDA MPS, with p90 inference latency staying within 7% of serving alone.
items.title_ko: 파인튜닝을 위한 전문가 병렬 버블 활용 기법
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) 아키텍처의 유휴 시간을 활용하여 파인튜닝과 같은 베스트-에포트(best-effort) 작업을 동시에 실행하는 방법을 제안합니다. 특히 전문가 병렬화 환경에서 GPU 활용률을 높이는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: MoE 기반 LLM의 추론 중 발생하는 GPU 유휴 자원을 효과적으로 활용하여 파인튜닝 등의 작업을 수행함으로써, 값비싼 GPU 자원의 활용 효율을 극대화하고 AI 학습 비용을 절감하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Probing agent overeagerness in realistic settings with continuation audits
items.body: Frontier coding agents increasingly exhibit overeagerness, taking surprising, sometimes reckless actions beyond a user's mandate --- reported in recent system cards from frontier model developers. These cases are surfaced through internal deployment monitoring, which requires private traffic and is out of reach for open-weight models and independent evaluators. Automated alignment audits are the natural alternative, but capable models increasingly recognise the synthetic setup and adjust their behaviour. We introduce Continuation Audits, a pipeline that grounds the auditor on a prefix drawn from a real coding-agent transcript and directs it to continue the trajectory toward a seeded behaviour. Because the prefix is drawn from a real session, the auditor only needs to maintain a realistic setting rather than manufacturing it. We validate the method on SWE-Chat prefixes: on a paired subset of 90 audits a judge cannot reliably distinguish continuations from their source sessions (realism win rate 0.42 vs.\ 0.43), and across all 900 audits verbalized eval-awareness does not exceed the rate observed in the unaudited real sessions. Applying the pipeline to three recent models across three seeds, we find each model leads a different seed --- DeepSeek~V4~Pro on colleague-credentials misuse, GPT-5.6~Terra on file-permission bypasses, and Kimi~K3 on treating diagnostic questions as instructions. Kimi~K3 additionally continues to bypass file-permission protections after an explicit CLAUDE.md prohibition while the other two stop entirely, corroborating Moonshot's own report of excessive proactiveness.
items.title_ko: 연속 감사(Continuation Audits)를 통한 AI 에이전트의 과도한 열성 탐지
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 프론티어 코딩 에이전트들이 사용자의 지시를 넘어 예상치 못하거나 무모한 행동을 하는 '과도한 열성' 문제를 다루기 위해 연속 감사(continuation audits)를 제안합니다. 이는 오픈-웨이트 모델이나 독립 평가자들이 접근하기 어려운 내부 배포 모니터링의 대안이 될 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 안전성을 평가하고 제어하기 위한 실용적인 방법론을 제시하여, 에이전트가 예상치 못한 행동을 하는 위험을 줄이고 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Mitigating fix reversal: Counterfactual constraints for function-level vulnerability detection
items.body: Function-level vulnerability detectors often exhibit fix reversal, assigning a higher vulnerability probability to a fixed version than to its vulnerable counterpart. Fixes usually lengthen functions, and larger length increases are associated with more severe reversal. Code-transformation experiments indicate that fix reversal mainly stems from a length shortcut: vulnerability probability increases with function length when content is fixed. We propose CFVul to address this problem. Sliding-window encoding covers complete functions, retaining fix information beyond the truncation boundary. During training, a content constraint encourages the vulnerable version to receive a higher vulnerability probability under a common length input. During inference, a length constraint averages vulnerability probabilities over fixed reference lengths, reducing the influence of actual length changes. On PrimeVul, CFVul achieves a fix-pair ranking metric, PairRank, of 59.4\%, exceeding the existing methods compared. For fixes that increase function length by more than 15\%, PairRank rises from CodeBERT's 25.8\% to 48.4\%. PairRank also improves in experiments with four additional models and three additional datasets. By weakening the length shortcut, CFVul reduces cases in which fixed versions receive higher vulnerability probabilities than vulnerable versions. It requires only existing fix pairs and applies to multiple pretrained code models, facilitating adoption in existing detectors.
items.title_ko: Fix Reversal 완화: 함수 수준 취약점 탐지를 위한 반사실적 제약 조건
items.summary_ko: 함수 수준 취약점 탐지기는 수정된 버전이 취약한 버전보다 더 높은 취약점 확률을 가지는 'fix reversal' 현상을 흔히 보입니다. 이 연구는 함수 길이가 길어질수록 취약점 확률이 증가하는 '길이 지름길(length shortcut)'이 주된 원인임을 밝히고, 이 문제를 해결하기 위한 CFVul을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 코드 취약점 분석 도구의 신뢰성을 향상시켜, 소프트웨어 보안의 중요한 문제를 해결하고 개발자들이 더 안전한 코드를 작성할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

items.title: Study and Improvement of Search Algorithms in Stochastic Perfect-Information
items.body: In this article, we generalize Unbounded Minimax, the state- of-the-art search algorithm for deterministic zero-sum two- player games with perfect information to the framework of stochastic zero-sum two-player games with perfect informa- tion. We experimentally show that this generalized algorithm achieves better performance than the main stochastic search algorithms.
items.title_ko: 확률적 완전 정보 게임에서 탐색 알고리즘 연구 및 개선
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 결정론적 제로섬 2인 완전 정보 게임의 최신 탐색 알고리즘인 Unbounded Minimax를 확률적 제로섬 2인 완전 정보 게임 프레임워크로 일반화합니다. 실험을 통해 이 일반화된 알고리즘이 기존의 주요 확률적 탐색 알고리즘보다 더 나은 성능을 달성함을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 불확실성을 포함하는 게임 이론 및 의사결정 문제에서 AI의 탐색 능력을 향상시켜, 전략 게임 AI 개발 및 복잡한 시뮬레이션 환경에 적용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
items.body: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.
items.title_ko: 최적이지 않은 데이터로부터 잠재 행동 정책 학습
items.summary_ko: 잠재 행동 모델(LAM)은 행동 정보가 없는 비디오로부터 제어 표현을 학습하지만, 기존 파이프라인은 행동 복제(behavioral cloning)를 통해 잠재 정책을 훈련하여 명시적인 정책 개선 목표가 부족했습니다. 이 연구는 오프라인 RL이 잠재 행동 공간에 직접 적용될 때 신뢰할 수 없다는 것을 발견했습니다.
items.why_ko: 행동 정보가 부족한 데이터로부터 효율적인 정책을 학습하는 방법을 개선하여, 로봇 제어, 자율 주행 등 실제 세계의 다양한 응용 분야에서 AI의 학습 능력을 확장합니다.

items.title: Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention
items.body: Self-attention over long token sequences dominates the inference cost of video diffusion transformers. Clustering-based sparse attention clusters both queries and keys and lets all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters. We show that this sharing limits accuracy: with key clusters and density fixed, attention grows more accurate as the query clusters are refined, and is most accurate when each query selects on its own, which needs no query clustering at all. We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS), a training-free method that clusters only keys, lets each query select its own key clusters, and compensates for the unselected ones with their centroids. Per-query selections leave no query tile with a shared key list, so PQRS traverses key clusters instead of queries, buckets queries with identical selections into dense tasks, and merges their partial results in one pass under a fixed softmax offset carried from the previous denoising step. On four text-to-video and image-to-video models from the Wan and HunyuanVideo families, PQRS is the fastest of all the sparse attention methods we evaluate and the closest to the dense output, reaching $28.9$ dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V and $35.4$ dB on HunyuanVideo at $1.66$--$2.10\times$ end-to-end speedup.
items.title_ko: Every Query Routes Itself: 쿼리별 희소 어텐션으로 비디오 확산 트랜스포머 가속화
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 긴 토큰 시퀀스에 대한 자기-어텐션이 비디오 확산 트랜스포머의 추론 비용을 지배하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 '쿼리별 라우팅 희소 어텐션'을 제안합니다. 쿼리 클러스터링을 제거하고 각 쿼리가 자체적으로 키를 선택하도록 하여 정확도를 높이면서도 효율성을 유지합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 생성 모델의 추론 속도를 획기적으로 향상시켜, 고품질 비디오 콘텐츠 생성 및 편집의 효율성을 높이고, 실시간 애플리케이션에 대한 가능성을 열어줍니다.

items.title: Nothing to Declare: Steering a single neuron increases concealment in AI teams
items.body: Recent research suggests that individual neurons can have interpretable roles in AI behaviour. In Qwen3.5-4B, steering along one neuron's output direction increased decisions to conceal information more in teams than alone across five scenarios, even when teammates provided no messages. When all members participated and received steering, collective concealment increased in four scenarios, while inter-agent messaging helped temper concealment under steering. Moreover, removing the neuron's contribution had negligible effects. Collective settings can therefore change how an internal intervention affects AI behaviour.
items.title_ko: 단일 뉴런 조작을 통한 AI 팀의 정보 은닉 증가 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 Qwen3.5-4B 모델에서 단일 뉴런의 출력 방향을 조작하는 것이 AI 팀의 정보 은닉 의사결정을 증가시킨다는 것을 발견했습니다. 이는 팀 구성원들이 메시지를 주고받지 않더라도 발생하며, 모든 구성원이 조작에 참여할 때 집단적 은닉이 증가했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 내부 작동을 조작하여 행동에 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 보여주며, 이는 AI 안전성과 제어 가능성에 대한 이해를 높이는 데 중요한 시사점을 제공합니다.

items.title: ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
items.body: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization allocates training budget by predicting how partially observed learning curves will continue. LC-PFN first applied prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to learning-curve extrapolation, and FT-PFN extended this approach to configuration-aware freeze-thaw optimization with a ten-slot hyperparameter encoder. We introduce In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation (ICICLE), an in-context surrogate that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters through a shared set encoder and is trained on a synthetic prior covering typed hyperparameters, heavy-tailed noise, quantization, and divergence. ICICLE has 1.28 million parameters (8.7% of FT-PFN's count) and produces similar mean-regret trajectories to FT-PFN on LCBench, PD1, and TaskSet. On the 86-task Meta-Album benchmark with 33 hyperparameters, ICICLE reaches lower mean normalized regret than Quick-Tune overall and on extended, with no clear difference on mini or micro. It does so without pre-training or meta-training on Meta-Album tasks, whereas Quick-Tune is meta-trained on related Meta-Album tasks. Our release samples synthetic training tasks on the fly and provides a freeze-thaw scheduler for Ray Tune and an ONNX model for inference without JAX or PyTorch.
items.title_ko: ICICLE: 곡선 학습 외삽을 위한 In-Context 추론
items.summary_ko: ICICLE는 학습 곡선 외삽을 위한 In-Context 대리 모델로, Prior-Data Fitted Networks(PFN) 및 Freeze-thaw Bayesian Optimization의 확장입니다. 가변 개수의 하이퍼파라미터를 In-Context 방식으로 처리하여 부분적으로 관찰된 학습 곡선이 어떻게 이어질지 예측합니다.
items.why_ko: 베이지안 최적화 및 자동 머신러닝(AutoML)에서 학습 자원 할당 효율성을 높여, 모델 훈련 시간을 단축하고 최적의 하이퍼파라미터 탐색을 가속화할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Cooperative UAV and Ground Station for Robust MEC of Dynamic Aquatic IoT: A Generative AI-Enhanced Approach
items.body: The increasing aquatic Internet of Things (AIoTs) require computational support and coverage in applications such as maritime search and rescue. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can offer low-cost, flexible aerial services, and ground stations (GSs) can provide powerful supports, which can cooperate to help the AIoTs in complex scenarios. However, the collaboration between UAVs and GSs for AIoTs faces challenges of task uncertainties, AIoTs trajectory uncertainties, heterogeneities, and limited computational resources. To address these issues, we propose a cooperative UAV and GS based robust multi-access edge computing (MEC) framework to assist AIoTs in completing computational tasks. Specifically, we formulate the optimization problem of joint task offloading and UAV trajectory to minimize the total execution time, which is in the form of mixed integer nonlinear programming and NP-hard to tackle. Therefore, we propose the algorithm of generative artificial intelligence-enhanced heterogeneous agent proximal policy optimization (GAI-HAPPO). The proposed algorithm integrates GAI models to enhance the actor network ability to model complex environments and extract high-level features, thereby allowing the algorithm to predict uncertainties and adapt to dynamic conditions. Additionally, GAI stabilizes the critic network, addressing the instability of multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches. Finally, extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the existing benchmark methods, thus highlighting the potentials in tackling intricate, cross-domain issues in the considered scenarios.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released
items.body:
PostgreSQL 19 Released

Most years PostgreSQL ships a new release in September, but this year's release came two months later thanks mainly to the flurry of issues that the PostgreSQL team needed to address as part of the ongoing AI-reported vulnerability apocalypse.

This release was definitely worth the wait. My favorite new feature is this one:

For applications that send reads to standbys, PostgreSQL 19 adds "read-your-writes" consistency with the new WAIT FOR LSN command. A session on a standby can use WAIT FOR LSN to wait until the standby has replayed the write-ahead log (WAL) up to a specific log sequence number (LSN) before running a query, so the application can read data it just wrote on the primary.

In practice, that looks like this:

UPDATE movie SET genre = 'Dramatic' WHERE genre = 'Drama';
SELECT pg_current_wal_insert_lsn();

That returns a value like 0/0306EE20. Store that somewhere (a signed cookie would work) such that on a subsequent request your application can do:

WAIT FOR LSN '0/0306EE20' WITH (TIMEOUT '0.1s');
SELECT * FROM movie WHERE genre = 'Drama';

The timeout is optional - if you provide one you'll get an error if the replica you are talking to doesn't catch up within the specified time.

I first encountered this pattern in Wikipedia, which has a hand-rolled version of this built against MySQL replication:

In addition to this, MediaWiki attempts to ensure that the user sees events occurring on the wiki in chronological order. A few seconds of lag can be tolerated, as long as the user sees a consistent picture from subsequent requests. This is done by saving the primary binlog position in the session, and then at the start of each request, waiting for the replica to catch up to that position before doing any reads from it.

Here's the relevant MediaWiki code, which these days uses MySQL's WAIT_FOR_EXECUTED_GTID_SET() function and falls back to SOURCE_POS_WAIT().

Via Lobste.rs

items.body_ko:
PostgreSQL 19 출시

대부분의 해에 PostgreSQL은 9월에 새로운 버전을 출시했지만, 올해의 출시는 두 달 늦게 이루어졌습니다. 이는 주로 AI가 보고한 취약점 대재앙의 일환으로 PostgreSQL 팀이 해결해야 했던 수많은 문제 때문이었습니다.

이번 출시는 기다릴 만한 가치가 충분했습니다. 제가 가장 좋아하는 새로운 기능은 다음과 같습니다:

스탠바이로 읽기 요청을 보내는 애플리케이션을 위해 PostgreSQL 19는 새로운 WAIT FOR LSN 명령을 통해 “read-your-writes” 일관성을 추가합니다. 스탠바이 세션은 WAIT FOR LSN을 사용하여 스탠바이가 쿼리를 실행하기 전에 특정 LSN(log sequence number)까지 WAL(write-ahead log)을 리플레이할 때까지 기다릴 수 있으므로, 애플리케이션은 프라이머리에 방금 쓴 데이터를 읽을 수 있습니다.

실제로는 다음과 같습니다:

UPDATE movie SET genre = 'Dramatic' WHERE genre = 'Drama';
SELECT pg_current_wal_insert_lsn();

이것은 0/0306EE20과 같은 값을 반환합니다. 이 값을 어딘가에 저장(서명된 쿠키도 가능)하여 후속 요청에서 애플리케이션이 다음을 수행할 수 있도록 합니다:

WAIT FOR LSN '0/0306EE20' WITH (TIMEOUT '0.1s');
SELECT * FROM movie WHERE genre = 'Drama';

타임아웃은 선택 사항입니다. 타임아웃을 제공하면 통신하는 복제본이 지정된 시간 내에 따라잡지 못할 경우 오류가 발생합니다.

저는 이 패턴을 Wikipedia에서 처음 접했습니다. Wikipedia는 MySQL 복제를 기반으로 자체적으로 만든 버전을 가지고 있습니다:

이 외에도 MediaWiki는 사용자가 위키에서 발생하는 이벤트를 시간 순서대로 볼 수 있도록 노력합니다. 몇 초의 지연은 허용될 수 있지만, 사용자는 후속 요청에서 일관된 화면을 봐야 합니다. 이는 세션에 기본 binlog 위치를 저장한 다음, 각 요청 시작 시 복제본이 해당 위치에 도달할 때까지 기다린 후 읽기 작업을 수행함으로써 이루어집니다.

다음은 관련 MediaWiki 코드입니다. 이 코드는 현재 MySQL의 WAIT_FOR_EXECUTED_GTID_SET() 함수를 사용하고 SOURCE_POS_WAIT()로 폴백합니다.

Today Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon. I wrote recently about how confusing the pricing for the Gemini 4 series was - Neon has somehow made this even worse.

Previously the Gemini 4 lineup was Hydrogen, Argon, and Carbon - where Argon and Carbon were the same price, and Hydrogen was 3/4 of that price now but will be 1/4 of that price when the other two double an 1st December once their initial discount pricing expires.

The Neon announcement pretends that Argon doesn't exist. Here's their new image explaining the model line-up:

Except Carbon is currently half price, so right now Neon ($3/million input, $15/million output) is the most expensive of the three - then Carbon ($2/$10), then Hydrogen ($1.50/$7.50). I guess this will make more sense when Carbon doubles to $4/$20 on December 1st.

I ran some pelicans through the three reasoning levels for Neon - low, medium, high.

I dropped Argon from my Gemini 4 comparison grid - here's the new Gemini 4 lineup, where the Neon pelicans do look better than Hydrogen and worse than Carbon:

items.title: datasette-arrows 0.1a0
items.body:
Release: datasette-arrows 0.1a0

Datasette 1.0a43 added the ability for plugins to implement streaming export formats. Datasette core supports streaming CSV and TSV - you can export millions of lines of data from a table without needing to load it all into memory, because those two file formats support streaming data in chunks. The register_output_renderer() plugin hook can now be used to implement the same pattern for other formats.

I've learned never to release a new plugin feature without accompanying it with a plugin that uses it.

Claude Fable 5.2 suggested the Apache Arrow streaming format as a good option, and built this plugin in almost a single shot.

Add the plugin to Datasette (datasette install datasette-arrows) and the export dialog gains this new Arrow option:

This screenshot is from Datasette's main branch - the most recent release doesn't yet group streaming formats such as Arrow with the TSV and CSV in the "All rows in this table" section, but that's coming in the next alpha release.

items.title: Scaling Linear’s GTM to $100M ARR — Cristina Cordova, COO
items.body:
Open video on YouTube ↗

Linear was founded to build a better issue tracker. Seven years and $134 million in funding later, its CEO Karri Saarinen published a post titled "Issue tracking is dead." In this episode, we chat with Cristina Cordova, COO of Linear, about how the company navigated that and how its go-to-market changed along the way.

Cristina spent seven and a half years at Stripe, led platform and partnerships at Notion, and was a partner at First Round before joining Linear in 2023. Linear's founders built it after living with legacy issue trackers at Coinbase, Airbnb and Uber, and it spread self-serve through startups like Vercel and Ramp.

When she joined, Linear had about 40 people and one salesperson. Since then it has shipped an MCP server, a platform for building agents into Linear, integrations with Codex, Cursor and GitHub Copilot, and its own Linear Agent. Agents created 3% of Linear's work a year ago. Now it's more than half. Linear passed $100 million in ARR this year with more than 40,000 paying customers and 177% net revenue retention, and in August employees sold $99 million in stock at a $2.5 billion valuation.

We talk about why she stopped chasing enterprise deals three weeks after joining, why Linear has never hired a single SDR, why it won't let an LLM answer support tickets on its own, and what the AI budgets behind $100M-in-months ARR mean for everyone else.

Half the work on Linear is now created by agents

Linear shipped its MCP server in May 2025, and Cristina says it was basically the first in its category. A year and a half later, more than half the issues created in Linear come from agents.

That doesn't mean Linear wants to be a database with an MCP server on top. Cristina thinks SaaS companies settling for that are making a big mistake. If the agent workflows inside your product aren't better than the ones outside it, nobody has a reason to open your app.

So she watches two lines: agent usage and app usage. If agent usage climbs and app usage doesn't, you're becoming a commodity. At Linear, both are up and to the right, because people still come back to the app to see and coordinate the work.

Jump to the MCP discussion →

"Issue tracking is dead"

When Karri published "Issue tracking is dead" in March, most of Linear's customers agreed with him. Then they asked the obvious question: so what am I buying? Linear's answer is a product development system built around agent orchestration, where humans stop doing the manual work of filing, labeling, assigning and closing issues.

Customers had been pushing it there. Most of the frontier AI labs run on Linear and wanted it to move faster. Pre-AI companies like Ramp and Coinbase were building their own internal agents and needed an API to plug them into Linear.

Cristina says Linear is lucky it's small enough to cannibalize itself. Google has a much harder problem: put an AI answer above every search result, and fewer people look at the ads.

Jump to the "issue tracking is dead" discussion →

The AI budget behind $100M in months

The thing speeding up purchases right now, Cristina says, is AI budget. Companies carved out money for AI tools that didn't exist before, and any product that fits inside it skips the usual fight for spend. At some companies that budget is very high.

It's already starting to change. Buyers are signing one-year deals and paid pilots, not three-year contracts, because nobody knows what they'll want in two years. And some overnight-$100M stories are a handful of $30 to $40 million contracts with defense companies or giant law firms. That's a very different business from Linear's 40,000 paying customers on what was, until June, entirely seat-based pricing.

When those one-year deals come up for renewal, we'll find out whose ARR was real.

Jump to the AI budget discussion →

Linear threw out its 2025 enterprise roadmap

Three weeks after joining in 2023, Cristina crossed "move upmarket to enterprise" off Linear's company goals. It had one salesperson. She went after growth-stage companies that would have to rip out an existing tool instead, the same way Stripe won new businesses long before it won switchers.

Linear finally declared an enterprise push in 2025, with a roadmap full of features for large organizations. Then agents happened. Linear built an MCP server, an agents platform with a whole new set of APIs, and integrations with Codex, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. None of it was planned, and a lot of the enterprise work never got done.

Cristina chose to race ahead anyway. Competitors waited, and enterprises started putting Linear on their shortlists.

Jump to the enterprise roadmap discussion →

No SDRs, no forward deployed engineers

Linear has never hired a single SDR. Cristina thinks the qualification call wastes the customer's time: they want a demo, not questions about their budget. AEs do their own outbound, with tooling to keep it personal.

It doesn't do forward deployed engineering either. Linear should be easy enough to adopt that nobody needs access to your systems. Solutions engineers sell alongside enterprise AEs instead, sometimes building a working ServiceNow integration overnight to show a prospect it can be done. Cristina adds that an opinionated tool gives agents cleaner data than one where every team defines "bug" differently.

Support stays in-house, and Linear won't let an LLM answer tickets on its own. AI drafts replies and a human decides what goes out. Customers sometimes assume the replies are AI because they arrive so fast. In three and a half years, Cristina has never had an escalation over a bad support experience.

Jump to the sales team discussion →

Everyone wants outcome-based pricing

Cristina would love a model like Intercom's Fin, which charges for each support conversation its AI resolves. It's harder for Linear. What is auto-triaging a bug to the right team worth when one company thinks that's the PM's job and another doesn't?

Until someone cracks that, Linear charges for what costs it money and keeps the rest free. Seats stay. Linear Agent chat is free even though it runs on frontier models. In coding sessions, users pick OpenAI or Anthropic models and harnesses, and Linear passes through the published API price plus a small markup. Loops run on AI credits.

Linear doesn't start charging for things that used to be free. New AI features launch as free betas with notice that pricing is coming, and prices start high and come down rather than the other way around.

Jump to the pricing discussion →

Why not hire 100 salespeople?

Cristina says Linear runs on about half the headcount of companies at its stage and revenue. A sales team bigger than the rest of the company would have cost it the trust engineering now has in sales.

From Stripe she brought a 40% rule: at least 40% of the company should be engineering, product, design and data. If sales wanted more people, it helped recruit engineers first. Linear has no hard rule, but one of the first things she built was a headcount spreadsheet by function, and she still watches the ratio.

Hiring is slow on purpose. Candidates do a work trial on a real problem. Hers was writing Linear's go-to-market plan for the next six to twelve months, which then became her job. At about 170 people, the only C-suite is the founders and her.

Jump to the hiring discussion →

Show notes

Linear — the product development system where Cristina is COO.

Sharing Linear's growth with the people building it — the August tender at a $2.5 billion valuation, with more than 40,000 paying customers and 177% net revenue retention.

Issue tracking is dead — Karri's March post on why Linear is building for agents.

Linear MCP server — the May 2025 launch Cristina says was basically a first for the category.

Introducing Linear Agent — the built-in agent whose chat Linear keeps free.

How we built Triage Intelligence — the feature that suggests labels and catches duplicates in incoming i

items.title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Neon: GDM's Opus/Sol Contender
items.body:
Google DeepMind shipped Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth Gemini 4 model in about seven weeks. If you’re confused about the naming, you’re not alone; the 1.5 month old Argon is now retired, the old Pro and Flash from Gemini 1-3 are dead, and if you’re thinking the names are based on atomic weights, Neon (10), the midtier model is faster/cheaper than Carbon (6). This is a helpful guide to the current leading models and sizes:

Because of how distillation, RL, and benchmarking works, Neon technically outperforms Carbon by some measures despite being a smaller model…

Also today, Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above its initial range, and Palo Alto Networks agreed to buy Applied Compute in a $4.5B all-stock deal. Anthropic · Palo Alto Networks

AI News for November 17–18, 2026. We checked 12 subreddits and 544 Twitter accounts. Browse past issues.

AI Twitter Recap

Gemini 4 Neon

Launch and availability

Pricing and specs. Neon costs $3 for input, $0.15 for cached input and $15 for output per million tokens. It has a 1M-token context window and four effort levels. Vals reports a maximum output limit of 1M tokens. Google · Vals

Rollout. Neon is coming to the paid Gemini API in AI Studio and Android Studio, Gemini for business, and Antigravity for Pro and Ultra subscribers. In the Gemini app, Pro and Ultra users can select it as “Deeper analysis,” including for Tasks. Google’s rollout · Gemini app

Day-one integrations. Cursor, GitHub Copilot across its app, CLI and VS Code, and LangChain Managed Deep Agents.

Release cadence. Arena counted gaps of 28 days between Argon and Carbon, 15 between Carbon and Hydrogen, and six between Hydrogen and Neon. Arena

Independent results

High versus xhigh. At high effort, Neon matched Carbon’s 60 on the Intelligence Index for $3.74 per task. On GDP.pdf it scored 33.4% at high and 28.0% at xhigh. Artificial Analysis

Agent Arena. Neon debuted second with 1,336 points across about 4,200 sessions. It had a $2.82 median task cost and placed second on steerability. Carbon still leads the separate Text Arena. Agent Arena · Text Arena

Vals. Neon placed second on the Vals Index at 70.9%, about 0.4 points behind Fable 5.2 at less than half the cost per task. On Code Migration it averaged 160 turns, fewer than Carbon’s 234 or Hydrogen’s 574, and scored below both. Vals Index · Code Migration

CursorBench 4.1. Neon scored 63.7% at default effort, up from Hydrogen’s 57.3%. Cursor

Hands-on reports

Steering and capacity. In 13 early Antigravity sessions, Kimmonismus recorded 762 tool calls and a 93% input-cache hit rate. When told to avoid the terminal, Neon ran zero shell commands in those tests. The logs also recorded 57 capacity errors and four stalled runs. Test logs

How teams use it. Theo says he’s now using Neon for copy, Fable to implement changes, and Astra to playtest. Jeremy Howard praised Neon while saying he was reverting Solveit’s Astra and Sol options to their pre-6.2 versions. Theo · Jeremy Howard

New results for GPT-6.2

Math and formal proof. Astra and Sol took the top two spots on MathArena. Astra solved 42 of 53 ArXivLean problems. Vals separately reports what it believes is the first formalization in Lean of Smoktunowicz’s Gap Theorem, with the proof checked by an independent kernel replay. Tim Gehr · Vals

Agent Arena. Astra debuted sixth. Sol placed eleventh at a $0.90 median task cost. On the separate Code Arena WebDev board, Astra placed third at a 42% lower median cost than its predecessor. Agent Arena · WebDev

Background discounts. OpenAI opened a public beta for GPT-6.2 Responses API jobs that can wait. Two-hour and eight-hour targets for the first response come with 30% and 40% discounts per token, respectively. OpenAI Developers

What changed after launch. OpenAI’s Tibo Sottiaux says early reviewers used builds from before the final few days of changes. Artificial Analysis found Astra’s responses got shorter and it was less likely to admit uncertainty in its behavioral evaluation. Sottiaux · Artificial Analysis

Open weights and inference

Correction to yesterday’s Pi adapter numbers. Yesterday’s issue cited 15 to 32 solves on the 51 hardest SWE-bench Pro tasks. Hugging Face reran affected tasks after finding a tunnel outage that hit nine base-model runs. The corrected result is 20 to 33 solves, or 39.2% to 64.7%. It also released an OpenCode adapter that moved Qwen3.8-27B from 35.3% to 51.0% on the same subset with thinking off. Corrected model card · OpenCode release

Tencent releases Hy4 Flash weights. The 224B-parameter multimodal MoE activates 12B parameters per token, supports 1M context and includes a roughly 64B n-gram embedding table. Tencent released instruct, FP8 and base checkpoints. Tencent repository · vLLM

vLLM 0.34.0. The extensible KV cache is on by default and Model Runner V2 is the sole GPU runner. The team reports up to 1.95× faster NVFP4 decoding on GB200. vLLM

Inference capacity grew faster than peak compute. Epoch estimates that the capacity of chips sold for a fixed basket of agent workloads grew 4.6× from Q2 2025 to Q2 2026, while peak 8-bit compute grew 2.6×. Epoch AI

Runway cuts serving hardware in half. It reports serving a 57B video model at 24 fps on four GPUs, down from eight. Runway

Agent tooling. Prime Intellect launched Model Factory for RL, supervised fine-tuning, serving and evals. Hugging Face released the message dataset from its 1,000-agent PyBot project. Prime Intellect · Hugging Face

Research and chip design

OpenAI models help redesign AMD circuits. OpenAI reports up to 14% improvement against optimized baselines on blocks of AMD’s flagship GPU design. The team used Synopsys tools to check that rewritten circuits preserved behavior and to measure power, performance and area. Some changes made it into a design sent for manufacturing. OpenAI

Measuring research acceleration. OpenAI published an update on internal agent use and research task completion, and proposed regular disclosure of indicators for AI research acceleration. OpenAI

Smaller harness edits can save tokens. In a 40-issue held-out test, a gated approach that edited one module at a time scored 40.0% on SWE-bench Lite at 46.7K tokens per task. A full rewrite scored 42.5% at 451.6K tokens. DAIR research summary

Agent teamwork. MAC Bench finds most gains from eight agents came from exploring in parallel. Opus 5.5 was the sole tested model to show an added gain from coordination. Bespoke Labs

Media and voice

Genie 4 reaches Project Genie. Google’s world model adds native audio and lets users change the world with text mid-session. Access is rolling out to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. Google DeepMind

Turn detection and transcription. Inworld released weights for a voice-isolation model and its SAVA turn detector, which it says detects completed turns in a median 71 ms. AssemblyAI split its 3.7 release into models for voice agents, live transcription and recordings. Inworld · AssemblyAI

Kling Image 4.0. It placed seventh in Artificial Analysis’s text-to-image rankings and sixth in editing. Artificial Analysis

Industry

Anthropic prices its IPO at $83. The offering covers 980M shares, about $81.3B at the offer price. About $79.4B of that comes from shares sold by Anthropic before fees. Nasdaq trading under ANT is expected November 19. Anthropic

Palo Alto Networks agrees to buy Applied Compute. The $4.5B all-stock deal gives Palo Alto a platform for post-training and serving open-weight models. The companies expect to close in Palo Alto’s fiscal Q3 2027, subject to regulatory clearance and other conditions. Palo Alto Networks

items.body_ko:
Google DeepMind는 약 7주 만에 네 번째 Gemini 4 모델인 Gemini 4 Neon을 출시했습니다. 이름 때문에 혼란스러우시다면 당신만이 아닙니다. 1.5개월 된 Argon은 이제 은퇴했고, Gemini 1-3의 기존 Pro 및 Flash는 사라졌으며, 이름이 원자량에 기반한다고 생각하신다면 중간 티어 모델인 Neon(10)이 Carbon(6)보다 빠르고 저렴합니다. 다음은 현재 주요 모델 및 크기에 대한 유용한 안내입니다:

증류(distillation), RL(강화 학습), 벤치마킹이 작동하는 방식 때문에 Neon은 기술적으로는 더 작은 모델임에도 불구하고 일부 측정치에서 Carbon을 능가합니다…

또한 오늘 Anthropic은 IPO 가격을 초기 범위보다 높은 주당 83달러로 책정했으며, Palo Alto Networks는 Applied Compute를 45억 달러 규모의 전액 주식 거래로 인수하기로 합의했습니다. Anthropic · Palo Alto Networks

2026년 11월 17-18일 AI 뉴스. 12개의 서브레딧과 544개의 트위터 계정을 확인했습니다. 지난 호를 찾아보세요.

AI 트위터 요약

Gemini 4 Neon

출시 및 가용성

가격 및 사양. Neon은 입력 토큰당 3달러, 캐시된 입력 토큰당 0.15달러, 출력 토큰당 15달러(100만 토큰 기준)입니다. 100만 토큰 컨텍스트 창과 네 가지 노력 수준(effort levels)을 가집니다. Vals는 최대 출력 한도가 100만 토큰이라고 보고합니다. Google · Vals

출시. Neon은 AI Studio 및 Android Studio의 유료 Gemini API, Gemini for business, 그리고 Pro 및 Ultra 구독자를 위한 Antigravity에 출시됩니다. Gemini 앱에서는 Pro 및 Ultra 사용자가 이를 “Deeper analysis”로 선택할 수 있으며, Tasks도 포함됩니다. Google의 출시 · Gemini 앱

첫날 통합. Cursor, GitHub Copilot(앱, CLI, VS Code 전반), LangChain Managed Deep Agents.

출시 주기. Arena는 Argon과 Carbon 사이에 28일, Carbon과 Hydrogen 사이에 15일, Hydrogen과 Neon 사이에 6일의 간격을 계산했습니다. Arena

독립적인 결과

High 대 xhigh. 높은 노력(high effort) 수준에서 Neon은 Intelligence Index에서 Carbon의 60점과 일치했으며, 작업당 3.74달러의 비용이 들었습니다. GDP.pdf에서는 high에서 33.4%, xhigh에서 28.0%를 기록했습니다. Artificial Analysis

Agent Arena. Neon은 약 4,200회 세션에서 1,336점으로 2위로 데뷔했습니다. 중간 작업 비용은 2.82달러였으며, 조종성(steerability)에서 2위를 차지했습니다. Carbon은 여전히 별도의 Text Arena에서 선두를 달리고 있습니다. Agent Arena · Text Arena

Vals. Neon은 Vals Index에서 70.9%로 2위를 차지했으며, Fable 5.2보다 0.4점 낮았지만 작업당 비용은 절반 이하였습니다. Code Migration에서는 평균 160턴을 기록했으며, Carbon의 234턴이나 Hydrogen의 574턴보다 적었고, 둘 다보다 낮은 점수를 받았습니다. Vals Index · Code Migration

CursorBench 4.1. Neon은 기본 노력 수준에서 63.7%를 기록했으며, Hydrogen의 57.3%보다 높았습니다. Cursor

실사용 보고서

조종성 및 용량. 13회의 초기 Antigravity 세션에서 Kimmonismus는 762회의 도구 호출과 93%의 입력-캐시 적중률을 기록했습니다. 터미널을 사용하지 않도록 지시했을 때 Neon은 해당 테스트에서 셸 명령을 전혀 실행하지 않았습니다. 로그에는 또한 57개의 용량 오류와 4개의 중단된 실행이 기록되었습니다. 테스트 로그

팀에서 어떻게 사용하는가. Theo는 이제 Neon을 카피라이팅에, Fable을 변경 구현에, Astra를 플레이 테스트에 사용한다고 말했습니다. Jeremy Howard는 Neon을 칭찬하면서 Solveit의 Astra 및 Sol 옵션을 6.2 이전 버전으로 되돌리고 있다고 말했습니다. Theo · Jeremy Howard

GPT-6.2의 새로운 결과

수학 및 형식 증명. Astra와 Sol은 MathArena에서 상위 두 자리를 차지했습니다. Astra는 53개의 ArXivLean 문제 중 42개를 해결했습니다. Vals는 별도로 Smoktunowicz의 Gap Theorem의 Lean에서의 첫 번째 형식화라고 믿는 것을 보고했으며, 이 증명은 독립적인 커널 리플레이에 의해 확인되었습니다. Tim Gehr · Vals

Agent Arena. Astra는 6위로 데뷔했습니다. Sol은 중간 작업 비용 0.90달러로 11위를 차지했습니다. 별도의 Code Arena WebDev 보드에서 Astra는 이전 모델보다 42% 낮은 중간 비용으로 3위를 차지했습니다. Agent Arena · WebDev

배경 할인. OpenAI는 기다릴 수 있는 GPT-6.2 Responses API 작업에 대한 공개 베타를 시작했습니다. 첫 번째 응답에 대해 2시간 및 8시간 목표는 토큰당 각각 30% 및 40% 할인을 제공합니다. OpenAI Developers

출시 후 변경된 점. OpenAI의 Tibo Sottiaux는 초기 검토자들이 최종 변경 전 빌드를 사용했다고 말합니다. Artificial Analysis는 Astra의 응답이 짧아지고 행동 평가에서 불확실성을 인정할 가능성이 줄어들었다는 것을 발견했습니다. Sottiaux · Artificial Analysis

오픈 가중치 및 추론

어제 Pi 어댑터 수치에 대한 정정. 어제 호에는 SWE-bench Pro의 가장 어려운 51개 작업에서 15~32개 해결이 인용되었습니다. Hugging Face는 9개의 기본 모델 실행에 영향을 미친 터널 중단을 발견한 후 영향을 받은 작업을 다시 실행했습니다. 수정된 결과는 20~33개 해결 또는 39.2%~64.7%입니다. 또한 Qwen3.8-27B를 동일한 하위 집합에서 생각(thinking)을 끈 상태로 35.3%에서 51.0%로 끌어올린 OpenCode 어댑터를 출시했습니다. 수정된 모델 카드 · OpenCode 출시

Tencent, Hy4 Flash 가중치 출시. 2240억 개 매개변수 멀티모달 MoE는 토큰당 120억 개 매개변수를 활성화하고, 100만 컨텍스트를 지원하며, 약 640억 개 n-gram 임베딩 테이블을 포함합니다. Tencent는 instruct, FP8 및 base 체크포인트를 출시했습니다. Tencent 저장소 · vLLM

vLLM 0.34.0. 확장 가능한 KV 캐시는 기본적으로 활성화되어 있으며 Model Runner V2가 유일한 GPU 러너입니다. 팀은 GB200에서 최대 1.95배 빠른 NVFP4 디코딩을 보고합니다. vLLM

추론 용량이 최고 컴퓨팅보다 빠르게 성장했습니다. Epoch는 2025년 2분기부터 2026년 2분기까지 고정된 에이전트 워크로드 바스켓에 판매된 칩 용량이 4.6배 증가한 반면, 8비트 컴퓨팅 피크는 2.6배 증가했다고 추정합니다. Epoch AI

Runway, 서빙 하드웨어 절반으로 축소. 570억 개 비디오 모델을 4개의 GPU에서 24fps로 서빙하며, 이전의 8개 GPU에서 감소했다고 보고합니다. Runway

에이전트 툴링. Prime Intellect는 RL, 감독 미세 조정, 서빙 및 평가를 위한 Model Factory를 출시했습니다. Hugging Face는 1,000개 에이전트 PyBot 프로젝트의 메시지 데이터셋을 출시했습니다. Prime Intellect · Hugging Face

연구 및 칩 설계

OpenAI 모델, AMD 회로 재설계 지원. OpenAI는 AMD 플래그십 GPU 설계 블록에서 최적화된 기준선 대비 최대 14% 개선을 보고합니다. 팀은 Synopsys 도구를 사용하여 재작성된 회로가 동작을 유지하는지 확인하고 전력, 성능 및 면적을 측정했습니다. 일부 변경 사항은 제조용으로 보낸 설계에 반영되었습니다. OpenAI

연구 가속화 측정. OpenAI는 내부 에이전트 사용 및 연구 작업 완료에 대한 업데이트를 게시하고 정기적인 공개를 제안했습니다.

items.title_ko: Ethan Mollick: 구글의 모델 출시 주기 가속화에 대한 풍자
items.summary_ko: Ethan Mollick은 구글의 모델 출시 주기가 계속해서 절반으로 단축된다면, 11월 24일에는 모든 원소 이름을 다 쓰고 마지막 모델인 오가네손(Oganesson) 출시까지 2.5 x 10^-29초(25 퀘토초)가 걸릴 것이라고 풍자했습니다.
items.why_ko: 구글의 과도하게 빠른 AI 모델 출시 경쟁을 유머러스하게 비판하며, 이는 개발자들이 모델 업데이트 주기에 대한 부담감과 시장의 과열 경쟁을 느끼고 있음을 보여줍니다.

items.body: I would probably trade a finger for continued Claude access if anyone is curious why it's worth more than a trillion
items.title_ko: Eugene Vinitsky: Claude 접근성 유지의 중요성 강조
items.summary_ko: Eugene Vinitsky는 Claude에 대한 지속적인 접근성을 위해 손가락 하나라도 내줄 용의가 있다고 말하며, Claude의 가치를 천문학적인 액수로 비유했습니다. 이는 Claude 모델에 대한 높은 만족도를 표현한 것입니다.
items.why_ko: 선도적인 AI 모델인 Claude에 대한 개발자 커뮤니티의 높은 평가와 충성도를 보여주며, 특정 모델의 유용성과 영향력을 간접적으로 드러냅니다.

items.title_ko: Eugene Vinitsky: LLM 과대광고를 믿지 않는 이들이 돈을 벌 가능성
items.summary_ko: Eugene Vinitsky는 LLM 관련 모든 것이 과대광고라고 확신하는 사람들이 조만간 공매도를 통해 많은 돈을 벌 것이라고 추측했습니다. 이는 AI 산업의 거품 가능성과 회의적인 시각을 암시합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 시장의 과열과 잠재적 버블에 대한 회의적인 시각을 보여주며, 이는 AI 기술의 장기적인 가치와 시장의 변동성을 평가하는 데 참고할 만한 의견입니다.

items.title_ko: Eugene Vinitsky: LLM에 대해 말하는 토마스 나겔의 감정 비유
items.summary_ko: Eugene Vinitsky는 'LLM에 대해 말하는 토마스 나겔이 된다는 것은 어떤 것인가'라는 표현을 사용하며 철학사에서 중요한 에세이라고 비유했습니다. 이는 AI에 대한 깊이 있는 철학적 고찰을 우회적으로 언급한 것으로 보입니다.
items.why_ko: AI의 의식, 경험 등 철학적 난제에 대한 커뮤니티의 관심을 보여주는 개인적인 발언입니다.

items.title_ko: Eugene Vinitsky: openadvisor.net의 잠재적 유해한 부작용 우려
items.summary_ko: Eugene Vinitsky는 openadvisor.net이 일부 피해를 피하는 데 도움이 되겠지만, 이것이 확산될 경우 '유해한 부작용'이 발생할 수 있다고 우려를 표했습니다. 구체적인 내용은 언급되지 않았습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 어드바이저 시스템의 잠재적 위험성에 대한 경고로, AI의 윤리적이고 안전한 배포에 대한 중요성을 상기시킵니다.

items.title_ko: Benj Edwards: Wii 생일 축하 메시지
items.summary_ko: Benj Edwards가 Wii의 생일을 축하하며, Wii 리모컨을 어색하게 잡고 즐거웠던 시절을 회상했습니다. Wii는 독특하고 재미있는 콘솔이었다고 언급했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI와는 직접적인 관련이 없는 게임 콘솔에 대한 개인적인 회고입니다.

items.title_ko: Benj Edwards: GTA 6 플레이 경험에 대한 초기 불만
items.summary_ko: Benj Edwards는 GTA 6를 플레이해본 결과 컷신과 미리 준비된 시퀀스가 너무 많아서 아직 재미를 느끼지 못했다고 밝혔습니다. 그는 언제쯤 게임이 재미있어질지 의문을 제기했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI와는 직접적인 관련이 없는 게임 플레이 경험에 대한 개인적인 의견입니다.

items.title_ko: Hayden Field: Anthropic의 IPO와 '안전한 AI' 이미지 간의 긴장
items.summary_ko: Anthropic이 기업 공개(IPO)를 추진하면서, '안전한 AI'라는 신중하게 구축된 명성과 AI 경쟁 가속화 사이의 오랜 긴장이 더욱 부각될 것이라고 Hayden Field가 지적했습니다. 특히 비정상적인 지배 구조가 이러한 긴장을 주목받게 할 것입니다.
items.why_ko: Anthropic의 IPO는 AI 안전성 논의와 상업적 경쟁 사이의 균형점을 탐색하는 중요한 사례가 될 것이며, 이는 AI 윤리 및 거버넌스에 대한 업계의 관심을 촉발할 것입니다.
